title.zh: 卷一百九十八 志第一百五十一 兵十二
title.raw: 卷一百九十八 志第一百五十一 兵十二 Volume 198 Treatises 151: Military 12

sentences.zh: 國馬之牧，歷五代浸廢，至宋而規制備具。

translations.literal: The keeping of state horses, through the Five Dynasties gradually fell into disuse; by the Song the regulations and systems were fully established.
translations.idiomatic: The state horse-breeding system had gradually declined through the Five Dynasties, but by the Song dynasty its regulations and institutions were fully in place.

sentences.zh: 自建隆而後，其官司之規，廄牧之政，與夫收市之利，牧地之數，支配之等，曰券馬，曰省馬，曰馬社，曰括買，沿革盛衰，皆可得而考焉。

translations.literal: From Jianlong onward, the regulations of its offices, the policies of stable pasture, and as for the profits of collection and marketing, the numbers of pasture lands, the grades of allocation — called coupon horses, provincial horses, horse societies, compulsory purchase — the evolution of rise and fall can all be examined.
translations.idiomatic: From the Jianlong era onward, the regulations governing its offices, pasture administration, the profits from procurement and marketing, the extent of grazing lands, and the grades of allocation — whether coupon horses, provincial horses, horse societies, or compulsory purchases — the entire history of their rise and decline can be traced.

sentences.zh: 凡御馬之等三，

translations.literal: In general, imperial horses had three grades,
translations.idiomatic: Imperial horses were divided into three grades,

sentences.zh: 〈（入殿祗候十五匹，引駕十四匹，從駕二十匹。）〉

translations.literal: (Fifteen horses for attendance in the hall, fourteen horses for leading the imperial carriage, twenty horses for escorting the carriage.)
translations.idiomatic: fifteen for hall attendance, fourteen for leading the imperial carriage, and twenty for escort duty.)

sentences.zh: 給用之等十有五，

translations.literal: grades for allocation and use numbered fifteen,
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen grades governed allocation and use,

sentences.zh: 〈（曰揀中，曰不得支使，曰添價，曰明信，曰臣僚，曰諸班，曰御龍直，曰捧日、龍衛，曰拱聖，曰驍騎，曰雲、武騎，曰天武、龍猛，曰配軍，曰雜使，曰馬鋪。）〉

translations.literal: (Called selected middle grade, not for dispatch, added price, bright trust, civil officials, various ranks, Imperial Dragon Guard Direct, Sun-bearer and Dragon Guard, Gong-sheng, Xiao-qi, Cloud and Martial Riders, Heavenly Martial and Dragon Fierce, assigned to army, miscellaneous servants, horse stations.)
translations.idiomatic: including "selected middle grade," "not for dispatch," "added price," "bright trust," civil officials, various ranks, the Imperial Dragon Guard Direct, the Sun-bearer and Dragon Guard units, Gong-sheng, Xiao-qi, the Cloud and Martial Riders, the Heavenly Martial and Dragon Fierce units, army assignment, miscellaneous servants, and horse stations.)

sentences.zh: 群號之字十有七，

translations.literal: the characters in herd names numbered seventeen,
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen characters were used in herd designations,

translations.literal: (Called "Left," "Right," "Thousand," "Stand," "Water," "Official," "Auspicious," "Heaven," "Lord," "King," "Square," "With," "Come," "Ten Thousand," "Small," "[damaged character] Official," "Retreat.")
translations.idiomatic: "Left," "Right," "Thousand," "Stand," "Water," "Official," "Auspicious," "Heaven," "Lord," "King," "Square," "With," "Come," "Ten Thousand," "Small," an undecipherable character followed by "Official," and "Retreat.")

sentences.zh: 毛物之種九十有二，

translations.literal: types of coat colors numbered ninety-two,
translations.idiomatic: Ninety-two varieties of coat color were recognized,

sentences.zh: 〈（叱撥之別八，青之別二，白之別一，烏之別五，赤之別五，紫之別六，駿之別十一，赭白之別六，騮之別八，騧之別六，駱之別五，騅之別五，騟之別八，駁胯之別六，駁之別三，驃之別七。）〉

translations.literal: (Chibo had eight subtypes, blue two, white one, black five, red five, purple six, jun eleven, ochre-white six, liu eight, gua six, luo five, zhui five, yu eight, piebald-flank six, piebald three, biao seven.)
translations.idiomatic: comprising eight subtypes of chibo, two of blue, one of white, five of black, five of red, six of purple, eleven of jun, six of ochre-white, eight of liu, six of gua, five of luo, five of zhui, eight of yu, six of piebald-flank, three of piebald, and seven of biao.)

sentences.zh: 其官司之規，則太祖承前代之制，初置左、右飛龍二院，以左、右飛龍二使領之。

translations.literal: As for the regulations of its offices, Taizu inherited the system of previous dynasties and initially established the Left and Right Flying Dragon two courtyards, with the Left and Right Flying Dragon two commissioners leading them.
translations.idiomatic: Regarding its administrative structure, Taizu adopted the institutions of earlier dynasties and initially established the Left and Right Flying Dragon courtyards, each headed by its own commissioner.

sentences.zh: 太平興國五年，改飛龍為天廄坊。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Taiping Xingguo, Flying Dragon was changed to Heavenly Stable Ward.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Taiping Xingguo (980), the Flying Dragon courtyards were renamed the Heavenly Stable Wards.

sentences.zh: 雍熙四年，改天廄為左、右騏驥院，左右天駟監四、左右天廄坊二皆隸焉。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongxi, Heavenly Stable was changed to the Left and Right Fine Steed courtyards; the four Left and Right Heavenly Horse Superintendencies and the two Left and Right Heavenly Stable Wards were all subordinate to them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yongxi (987), the Heavenly Stable Wards were reorganized as the Left and Right Fine Steed courtyards, to which the four Heavenly Horse Superintendencies and the two Heavenly Stable Wards were all subordinated.

sentences.zh: 真宗咸平元年，創置估馬司。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianping under Emperor Zhenzong, the Horse Appraisal Office was newly established.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianping (998), Emperor Zhenzong established the Horse Appraisal Office.

sentences.zh: 凡市馬，掌辨其良駑，平其直，以分給諸監。

translations.literal: For all horse marketing, it was in charge of distinguishing good from inferior horses, setting fair prices, and distributing them among the various superintendencies.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever horses were purchased, this office assessed their quality, set fair prices, and allocated them among the various pasture superintendencies.

sentences.zh: 三年，置群牧使，以內臣勾當制置群牧司，京朝官為判官。

translations.literal: In the third year, a Herd Pasture Commissioner was established; an inner-court official was assigned to manage the Herd Pasture Bureau, with a capital official serving as administrative judge.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later, a Herd Pasture Commissioner was appointed; an inner-court eunuch was placed in charge of the Herd Pasture Bureau, with a capital official serving as its administrative judge.

sentences.zh: 景德二年，改諸州牧龍坊悉為監，賜名，鑄印以給之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingde, all Dragon-Pasture Wards in the various prefectures were changed to superintendencies, given names, and seals were cast and issued to them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jingde (1005), all Dragon-Pasture Wards in the prefectures were converted into superintendencies, each granted an official name and issued a cast seal.

sentences.zh: 在外之監十有四：大名曰大名，洺州曰廣平，衛州曰淇水，並分第一、第二。

translations.literal: There were fourteen superintendencies outside the capital: Daming was called Daming, Luozhou was called Guangping, Weizhou was called Qishui — each divided into First and Second.
translations.idiomatic: There were fourteen superintendencies outside the capital: Daming (at Daming Prefecture), Guangping (at Luozhou), and Qishui (at Weizhou), each divided into first and second divisions.

sentences.zh: 河南曰洛陽，鄭州曰原武，同州曰沙苑，相州曰安陽，澶州曰鎮寧，邢州曰安國，中牟曰淳澤，許州曰單鎮。

translations.literal: Henan was called Luoyang, Zhengzhou was called Yuanwu, Tongzhou was called Shayuan, Xiangzhou was called Anyang, Cangzhou was called Zhenning, Xingzhou was called Anguo, Zhongmou was called Chunze, Xuzhou was called Danzhen.
translations.idiomatic: The others were Luoyang (Henan), Yuanwu (Zhengzhou), Shayuan (Tongzhou), Anyang (Xiangzhou), Zhenning (Cangzhou), Anguo (Xingzhou), Chunze (Zhongmou), and Danzhen (Xuzhou).

sentences.zh: 四年，以知樞密院陳堯叟為群牧制置使，又別置群牧使副、都監，增判官為二員。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Chen Yaosou, Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Herd Pasture Commissioner-in-Chief; deputy commissioners and chief superintendents were also separately established, and the administrative judges were increased to two posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Chen Yaosou, Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed Herd Pasture Commissioner-in-Chief; deputy commissioners and chief superintendents were also added, and the number of administrative judges was increased to two.

sentences.zh: 凡廄牧之政，皆出於群牧司，自騏驥院而下，皆聽命焉。

translations.literal: All stable-pasture policies issued from the Herd Pasture Bureau; from the Fine Steed courtyards downward, all obeyed its orders.
translations.idiomatic: All pasture administration issued from the Herd Pasture Bureau, and every office from the Fine Steed courtyards downward fell under its authority.

sentences.zh: 諸州有牧監，知州、通判兼領之，諸監各置勾當官二員。

translations.literal: The various prefectures had pasture superintendencies, concurrently headed by the prefect and the vice-prefect; each superintendency had two managing officials.
translations.idiomatic: Each prefecture had pasture superintendencies concurrently overseen by the prefect and vice-prefect, and each superintendency was staffed with two managing officials.

sentences.zh: 又置左右廂提點。

translations.literal: Left and Right Wing inspectors were also established.
translations.idiomatic: Inspectors for the left and right wings were also appointed.

sentences.zh: 又置牧養上下監，以養療京城諸坊、監病馬。

translations.literal: Upper and Lower Pasture-Nurture superintendencies were also established to raise and treat sick horses from the various wards and superintendencies in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Upper and Lower Pasture-Nurture superintendencies were also set up to care for and treat sick horses from the capital's various wards and superintendencies.

sentences.zh: 又詔左右騏驥院諸坊、監官，並以三年為滿；

translations.literal: It was also decreed that officials of the various wards and superintendencies under the Left and Right Fine Steed courtyards would serve three-year terms;
translations.idiomatic: An edict also fixed three-year terms for officials of the wards and superintendencies under the Left and Right Fine Steed courtyards;

sentences.zh: 如習知馬事願留者，群牧司以聞，而徙蒞他監焉。

translations.literal: if one was skilled and knowledgeable in horse affairs and wished to remain, the Herd Pasture Bureau would report it, and he would be transferred to take charge of another superintendency.
translations.idiomatic: those skilled in horse management who wished to stay on would be reported to the throne by the Herd Pasture Bureau and transferred to another superintendency.

sentences.zh: 其廄牧之政，則自太祖置養馬務一，葺舊務四，以為牧放之地始。

translations.literal: As for stable-pasture policy, it began when Taizu established one Horse-Rearing Office and restored four old offices as pasture lands.
translations.idiomatic: Pasture administration began when Taizu established one Horse-Rearing Office and restored four former offices as grazing lands.

sentences.zh: 太平興國四年，太宗觀兵於幽，得汾、晉、燕、薊之馬四萬二千餘匹，內皂充刃，始分置諸州牧養之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, Taizong reviewed troops at You and obtained more than forty-two thousand horses from Fen, Jin, Yan, and Ji; the inner stables were filled to capacity, and they were first distributed among the various prefectures for pasture rearing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo (979), Taizong inspected troops at You and acquired more than forty-two thousand horses from Fen, Jin, Yan, and Ji. With the imperial stables full to capacity, the horses were distributed among the prefectures for pasture rearing.

sentences.zh: 時殿直李諤坐贓，監牧許州，盜官菽，馬多死，並主吏斬於市。

translations.literal: At the time, Palace Direct Li E was convicted of corruption while supervising pasture at Xuzhou; he stole official fodder beans and many horses died — he and the chief clerk were both executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: Around this time, Palace Direct Li E was convicted of corruption while supervising pasture at Xuzhou; he had stolen official fodder, and many horses died. He and the chief clerk were both executed in public.

sentences.zh: 又詔擇豐曠地置牧龍坊八，以便牧養。

translations.literal: It was also decreed that eight Dragon-Pasture Wards be established on rich, open lands to facilitate pasture rearing.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also ordered eight Dragon-Pasture Wards established on fertile, open lands to facilitate grazing.

sentences.zh: 淳化二年十二月，詔圉人取善馬數十匹，於便殿設皂棧，教以秣飼，且以其法諭宰執，仍頒於諸軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the second year of Chunhua, it was decreed that grooms select several dozen fine horses, set up stables and mangers in the informal hall, teach feeding methods, explain the method to the chief ministers, and also promulgate it to the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second year of Chunhua (991), grooms were ordered to select several dozen fine horses and set up stables and mangers in the informal hall to demonstrate proper feeding. The method was explained to the chief ministers and promulgated to the various armies.

sentences.zh: 復以醫馬良方賜近臣。

translations.literal: Fine prescriptions for treating horses were also bestowed on close ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Effective prescriptions for treating horses were also bestowed on the emperor's close advisers.

sentences.zh: 嘗從趙守倫之請，於諸州牧龍坊畜牝馬萬五千匹，逐水草牧放，不費芻秣，生駒蕃息，足資軍用。

translations.literal: Following Zhao Shoulun's request, fifteen thousand brood mares were kept at the various Dragon-Pasture Wards, pastured according to water and grass without expending fodder; foals multiplied and abundantly supplied military use.
translations.idiomatic: At Zhao Shoulun's recommendation, fifteen thousand brood mares were kept at the Dragon-Pasture Wards across the prefectures and pastured according to available water and grass, saving fodder costs. Foals multiplied in abundance, fully supplying military needs.

sentences.zh: 至是，守倫復言：「諸坊牧馬萬匹，歲當生駒四千，今歲止二千五百，典司失職，當嚴責罰。

translations.literal: At this time, Shoulun again said: "The wards pasture ten thousand horses; each year they should produce four thousand foals, but this year there were only two thousand five hundred. The responsible officials have failed in duty and should be strictly punished.
translations.idiomatic: At this point Shoulun reported again: "The wards pasture ten thousand horses and should produce four thousand foals each year, yet this year there were only twenty-five hundred. The responsible officials have failed in their duties and should be strictly punished.

sentences.zh: 若馬百匹歲得駒七十，則加遷擢。

translations.literal: If a hundred horses produce seventy foals in a year, then promotion should be added.
translations.idiomatic: If a herd of one hundred horses produces seventy foals in a year, the officials should receive accelerated promotion.

sentences.zh: 諸坊產駒，即籍以聞。

translations.literal: Foals produced at the various wards should immediately be registered and reported.
translations.idiomatic: Foals born at the wards should be registered and reported immediately.

sentences.zh: 牧放軍人，當募少壯充役。」

translations.literal: Soldiers for pasture duty should be recruited from young and strong men for service."
translations.idiomatic: Pasture soldiers should be recruited from young and able-bodied men."

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All of these recommendations were approved.

sentences.zh: 真宗大中祥符元年，立牧監賞罰之令，外監息馬，一歲終以十分為率，死一分以上勾當官罰一月奉，餘等第決杖。

translations.literal: In the first year of Dazhong Xiangfu under Emperor Zhenzong, reward-and-punishment orders for pasture superintendencies were established. For outer superintendencies raising horses, at year's end taking ten parts as the standard, if deaths exceeded one part the managing official was fined one month's salary, and the rest received graduated beatings.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Dazhong Xiangfu (1008), reward-and-punishment regulations for pasture superintendencies were established. For outer superintendencies, deaths exceeding one tenth of the herd by year's end would cost the managing official one month's salary, with further graduated corporal punishments for higher mortality rates.

sentences.zh: 牧倍多而死少者，給賞緡有差。

translations.literal: Those with many births and few deaths received cash rewards in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Officials whose herds showed high birth rates and low mortality received cash rewards in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 凡生駒一匹，兵校而下賞絹一匹。

translations.literal: For each foal born, from military officers downward, one bolt of silk was rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: For every foal born, military officers and men below them each received one bolt of silk as a reward.

sentences.zh: 當是時，凡內外坊、監及諸軍馬凡二十餘萬匹，飼馬兵校一萬六千三十八人。

translations.literal: At that time, horses at inner and outer wards, superintendencies, and various armies totaled more than two hundred thousand; horse-feeding military officers and soldiers numbered sixteen thousand thirty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, horses kept at inner and outer wards, superintendencies, and various armies totaled more than two hundred thousand, tended by sixteen thousand thirty-eight military officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 每歲京城草六十六萬六千圍，麩料六萬二千二百四石，鹽、油、藥、糖九萬五千餘斤、石，諸州軍不預焉。

translations.literal: Each year the capital consumed six hundred sixty-six thousand bundles of hay, sixty-two thousand two hundred four shi of bran fodder, and more than ninety-five thousand jin and shi of salt, oil, medicine, and sugar — the various prefectures and armies were not included.
translations.idiomatic: Each year the capital alone consumed six hundred sixty-six thousand bundles of hay, sixty-two thousand two hundred four shi of bran fodder, and more than ninety-five thousand jin and shi of salt, oil, medicine, and sugar — not counting supplies for prefectures and garrisons elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 左右騏驥六坊、監止留馬二千餘匹，皆春季出就牧，孟冬則別其羸病，就棧皂養飼。

translations.literal: The six wards and superintendencies of the Left and Right Fine Steed courtyards kept only more than two thousand horses; all went out to pasture in spring, and in early winter the weak and sick were separated and kept in stables and mangers for feeding.
translations.idiomatic: The six wards and superintendencies under the Left and Right Fine Steed courtyards kept only about two thousand horses. Each spring they were turned out to pasture, and in early winter the weak and sick were separated and kept in stables for stall feeding.

sentences.zh: 其尚乘之馬，唯備用者在焉。

translations.literal: As for horses of the Imperial Carriage Office, only those held in reserve remained there.
translations.idiomatic: Only reserve horses for the Imperial Carriage Office were kept on site.

sentences.zh: 凡牧監之在河南、北，天禧後，靈昌監為河決所衝。

translations.literal: As for pasture superintendencies south and north of the Yellow River, after Tianxi the Lingchang Superintendency was struck by a Yellow River breach.
translations.idiomatic: Among the pasture superintendencies north and south of the Yellow River, the Lingchang Superintendency was devastated by a Yellow River breach after the Tianxi era.

sentences.zh: 至乾興、天聖間，兵久不試，言者多以為牧馬費廣而亡補，乃廢東平監，以其地賦民。

translations.literal: By the Qianxing and Tiansheng periods, troops had long gone untested; memorialists widely held that horse pasture was costly and without benefit, so the Dongping Superintendency was abolished and its land assigned to the people as tax land.
translations.idiomatic: By the Qianxing and Tiansheng periods, the army had long gone untested, and critics widely argued that horse pasture was costly and unproductive. The Dongping Superintendency was abolished and its land distributed to the people.

sentences.zh: 五年，廢單鎮監。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the Danzhen Superintendency was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, the Danzhen Superintendency was abolished.

sentences.zh: 六年，廢洛陽監。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the Luoyang Superintendency was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, the Luoyang Superintendency was abolished.

sentences.zh: 於是河南諸監皆廢，悉以馬送河北。

translations.literal: Thereupon all superintendencies south of the Yellow River were abolished, and all horses were sent north of the river.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon all superintendencies south of the Yellow River were abolished, and all horses were transferred north of the river.

sentences.zh: 既而詔取原武監馬赴京師，移河北孳生馬牧於原武。

translations.literal: Subsequently it was decreed that horses from the Yuanwu Superintendency be brought to the capital, and breeding horses from north of the river be pastured at Yuanwu.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, horses from the Yuanwu Superintendency were ordered to the capital, and breeding horses from north of the river were transferred to pasture at Yuanwu.

sentences.zh: 八年，群牧司上言：原武地廣而馬少，請增牧數。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the Herd Pasture Bureau memorialized: Yuanwu had broad lands but few horses; it requested an increase in pasture numbers.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, the Herd Pasture Bureau reported that Yuanwu had ample land but too few horses and requested an increase in the herd.

sentences.zh: 詔以淇水第二監四歲馬屬原武，歲取河北孳生四歲馬分屬淇水第二並原武監，移原武下等馬牧於靈昌鎮廢監，仍隸原武。

translations.literal: It was decreed that four-year-old horses of the Second Qishui Superintendency be assigned to Yuanwu; each year four-year-old breeding horses from north of the river be divided between the Second Qishui and Yuanwu superintendencies; inferior horses from Yuanwu be pastured at the abolished superintendency site at Lingchang Town, still subordinate to Yuanwu.
translations.idiomatic: An edict assigned four-year-old horses from the Second Qishui Superintendency to Yuanwu. Each year, four-year-old breeding horses from north of the river were divided between the Second Qishui and Yuanwu superintendencies, while inferior horses from Yuanwu were pastured at the abandoned Lingchang Town site, still under Yuanwu's jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 九年，詔諸監孳生駁馬，四時遊牧，勿復登廄。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, it was decreed that piebald breeding horses at the various superintendencies should graze in all four seasons and no longer be brought into stables.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, breeding piebald horses at the various superintendencies were ordered to graze year-round and no longer be stabled.

sentences.zh: 明道元年，議者謂：「自河南六監廢，京師須馬，取之河北，道遠非便。」

translations.literal: In the first year of Mingdao, discussants said: "Since the six superintendencies south of the Yellow River were abolished, when the capital needs horses and obtains them from north of the river, the distance is inconvenient."
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Mingdao (1032), critics argued: "Since the six superintendencies south of the Yellow River were abolished, obtaining horses for the capital from north of the river is inconvenient given the distance."

sentences.zh: 詔遣左廂提點王舜臣往度利害。

translations.literal: It was decreed that Wang Shunchen, Left Wing Inspector, be sent to assess advantages and disadvantages.
translations.idiomatic: The court dispatched Wang Shunchen, Inspector of the Left Wing, to assess the situation.

sentences.zh: 舜臣言：「鎮寧、靈昌、東平、淳澤四監雖廢，然其地猶牧本監並騏驥院馬，洛陽、單鎮去京師近，罷之非便。」

translations.literal: Shunchen said: "Although the four superintendencies of Zhenning, Lingchang, Dongping, and Chunze were abolished, their lands still pasture horses of the original superintendencies and the Fine Steed courtyards. Luoyang and Danzhen are close to the capital — abolishing them is inconvenient."
translations.idiomatic: Shunchen reported: "Although the Zhenning, Lingchang, Dongping, and Chunze superintendencies were abolished, their lands still graze horses for the original superintendencies and the Fine Steed courtyards. Luoyang and Danzhen are close to the capital, and abolishing them would be impractical."

sentences.zh: 乃詔復二監，以牧河北孳生馬。

translations.literal: Thereupon it was decreed that the two superintendencies be restored to pasture breeding horses from north of the river.
translations.idiomatic: The two superintendencies were accordingly restored to pasture breeding horses from north of the river.

sentences.zh: 景祐二年，揀河北諸監馬一千九百牧於趙州界，隸安陽監。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingyou, one thousand nine hundred horses selected from various superintendencies north of the river were pastured within Zhao Prefecture's borders, subordinate to the Anyang Superintendency.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jingyou (1035), nineteen hundred horses selected from superintendencies north of the river were pastured within Zhao Prefecture, under the Anyang Superintendency.

sentences.zh: 既而詔廣平廢監留其一，以趙州界牧馬復隸焉，所餘一監，毋毀廄舍。

translations.literal: Subsequently it was decreed that of the abolished Guangping superintendencies one be retained; horses pastured within Zhao Prefecture were again subordinate to it, and of the remaining superintendency the stable buildings were not to be destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, one of the abolished Guangping superintendencies was retained, and the horses pastured within Zhao Prefecture were placed under its jurisdiction again. The stable buildings of the remaining superintendency were ordered preserved.

sentences.zh: 四年，復以原武第二監為單鎮，移於長葛縣，以縣令、都監兼領之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the Second Yuanwu Superintendency was again made Danzhen and moved to Changge County, concurrently headed by the county magistrate and chief superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, the Second Yuanwu Superintendency was reestablished as Danzhen and relocated to Changge County, concurrently overseen by the county magistrate and chief superintendent.

sentences.zh: 三年，詔院坊、監馬歲留備用外，餘為兩群，牧於咸豐門外牟駝岡。

translations.literal: In the third year, it was decreed that besides horses kept in reserve each year from the courtyards, wards, and superintendencies, the remainder be formed into two herds and pastured at Motuogang outside Xianfeng Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, horses from the courtyards, wards, and superintendencies beyond those kept in reserve each year were formed into two herds and pastured at Motuogang outside Xianfeng Gate.

sentences.zh: 凡收養病馬，估馬司、騏驥院取病淺者送上監，深者送下監，分十槽醫療之。

translations.literal: For all sick horses taken in for care, the Horse Appraisal Office and Fine Steed courtyards sent lightly sick ones to the Upper Superintendency and seriously sick ones to the Lower Superintendency, dividing them into ten stalls for medical treatment.
translations.idiomatic: When sick horses were taken in for care, the Horse Appraisal Office and Fine Steed courtyards sent mildly ill horses to the Upper Superintendency and seriously ill ones to the Lower Superintendency, where they were divided among ten stalls for treatment.

sentences.zh: 天聖六年，詔月以都監、判官一人提舉。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tiansheng, it was decreed that each month one chief superintendent or administrative judge would oversee the matter.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Tiansheng (1028), one chief superintendent or administrative judge was assigned each month to oversee the operation.

sentences.zh: 八年，言者謂上監去京城遠，送病馬非便。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, memorialists said the Upper Superintendency was far from the capital and sending sick horses there was inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, critics noted that the Upper Superintendency was too far from the capital, making it inconvenient to transport sick horses there.

sentences.zh: 詔廢之，以病淺馬分屬左右騏驥院六坊、監，季較拋死數，歲終第賞罰。

translations.literal: It was decreed abolished; lightly sick horses were divided among the six wards and superintendencies of the Left and Right Fine Steed courtyards; death rates from abandonment were compared quarterly, and rewards and punishments were graded at year's end.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished, and mildly ill horses were distributed among the six wards and superintendencies of the Left and Right Fine Steed courtyards. Abandonment and mortality rates were compared quarterly, with rewards and punishments graded at year's end.

sentences.zh: 更以騏驥院官迭往提舉。

translations.literal: Fine Steed courtyard officials were instead sent in rotation to oversee the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Fine Steed courtyard officials were instead assigned in rotation to oversee the operation.

sentences.zh: 明道二年，復置上監，易名天，養無病馬，病馬並屬下監。

translations.literal: In the second year of Mingdao, the Upper Superintendency was restored, renamed Tian, to raise healthy horses; sick horses were all assigned to the Lower Superintendency.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Mingdao (1033), the Upper Superintendency was restored under the name Tian to care for healthy horses, while all sick horses were assigned to the Lower Superintendency.

sentences.zh: 景祐二年，詔以牧養監馬團群牧於陳、許州界鳳凰陂，免耗芻菽，歲以為常。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingyou, it was decreed that horses of the Pasture-Nurture superintendencies be herded in groups and pastured at Fenghuang Po on the borders of Chen and Xu prefectures, saving fodder consumption — this became the annual practice.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jingyou (1035), horses from the Pasture-Nurture superintendencies were ordered herded in groups and pastured at Fenghuang Po on the Chen-Xu prefectural border, saving fodder costs. This became standard practice.

sentences.zh: 治平二年，詔院坊、監馬之病不堪估賣者，送淇水第一監，別為一群以牧養之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhiping, it was decreed that sick horses from the courtyards, wards, and superintendencies unfit for appraisal and sale be sent to the First Qishui Superintendency and separately pastured as one herd.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhiping (1065), sick horses from the courtyards, wards, and superintendencies that were unfit for appraisal and sale were sent to the First Qishui Superintendency and pastured as a separate herd.

sentences.zh: 凡馬之孳生，則大名府、洺、衛、相州七監多擇善種，合牝牡為群，判官歲以十二月巡行坊、監，閱二歲駒點印，第賞牧兵。

translations.literal: As for horse breeding, the seven superintendencies of Daming Prefecture, Luozhou, Weizhou, and Xiangzhou mostly selected fine breeds, combined mares and stallions into herds; the administrative judge each year in the twelfth month inspected the wards and superintendencies, examined two-year-old foals and branded them, and graded rewards for pasture soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: For horse breeding, the seven superintendencies at Daming Prefecture, Luozhou, Weizhou, and Xiangzhou selected fine breeding stock and formed mare-stallion herds. Each December the administrative judge inspected the wards and superintendencies, branded two-year-old foals, and graded rewards for pasture soldiers.

sentences.zh: 諸軍收駒及二歲，即送官。

translations.literal: Foals collected by the various armies, once two years old, were immediately sent to the government.
translations.idiomatic: Foals collected by the various armies were sent to the government once they reached two years of age.

sentences.zh: 天聖七年，群牧司言：「舊制，知州軍、通判領同群牧事，歲終較馬死數及分已上，並生駒不及四分，並罰奉。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tiansheng, the Herd Pasture Bureau said: "Under the old system, prefects and vice-prefects jointly oversaw herd pasture affairs. At year's end, if horse deaths reached one tenth or more, and foals born did not reach four tenths, salaries were all fined.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Tiansheng (1029), the Herd Pasture Bureau reported: "Under the old system, prefects and vice-prefects jointly oversaw pasture affairs. At year's end, officials were fined if horse deaths exceeded one tenth or if foals born fell short of four tenths of the herd.

sentences.zh: 死數少，生駒多，即奏第賞。

translations.literal: If deaths were few and foals many, then graded rewards were memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: Low mortality and high foal production earned graded rewards reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 三歲都比，以該賞者聞。

translations.literal: Comparisons were made every three years, and those qualifying for reward were reported.
translations.idiomatic: Performance was compared every three years, and qualifying officials were reported for reward.

sentences.zh: 今請申明舊制，通判始到官，書所轄馬數，歲一考之，官滿，較總數為賞罰。」

translations.literal: Now we request clarification of the old system: when a vice-prefect first takes office, record the number of horses under jurisdiction; examine once per year; when the term ends, compare totals for rewards and punishments."
translations.idiomatic: We now request that the old system be clarified: when a vice-prefect first takes office, the number of horses under his jurisdiction should be recorded; annual assessments should be conducted; and at the end of his term, totals should be compared to determine rewards and punishments."

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: The decree approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐八年，群牧司言：「孳生七監，每監歲定牝馬二千，牡馬四百，歲約生駒四百，以為定數。」

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Jiayou, the Herd Pasture Bureau said: "The seven breeding superintendencies — each superintendency annually fixes two thousand brood mares, four hundred stallions, and approximately four hundred foals per year as the fixed quota."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Jiayou (1063), the Herd Pasture Bureau reported: "Each of the seven breeding superintendencies is allotted two thousand brood mares, four hundred stallions, and an expected four hundred foals per year as fixed quotas."

sentences.zh: 治平二年，詔：「諸監生駒滿三十月已上，每歲點印，選牡之良者送淇水第二監，餘雜大馬悉送河南三監，其淇水第二監馬，候滿六十月，給配諸監。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhiping, it was decreed: "Foals at the various superintendencies thirty months and older — each year brand them; select fine stallions and send to the Second Qishui Superintendency; send all remaining mixed large horses to the three superintendencies south of the Yellow River; horses of the Second Qishui Superintendency, when sixty months full, are allocated and paired to the various superintendencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhiping (1065), an edict ordered: "Foals at the various superintendencies thirty months and older should be branded each year. Fine stallions were to be sent to the Second Qishui Superintendency, and all remaining mixed adult horses to the three superintendencies south of the Yellow River. Horses at the Second Qishui Superintendency, once sixty months old, were to be allocated among the various superintendencies.

sentences.zh: 諸監牝馬滿三十月，本監別立群牧放，候滿五十月，乃撥配他監。」

translations.literal: Brood mares at the various superintendencies, when thirty months full, are separately formed into herds and pastured at the home superintendency; when fifty months full, they are then transferred and paired to other superintendencies."
translations.idiomatic: Brood mares at the various superintendencies, once thirty months old, were to be formed into separate herds and pastured at their home superintendency; once fifty months old, they were to be transferred and paired at other superintendencies."

sentences.zh: 凡收市馬，戎人驅馬至邊，總數十、百為一券，一馬預給錢千，官給芻粟，續食至京師，有司售之，分隸諸監，曰券馬。

translations.literal: As for collected and marketed horses, frontier peoples drove horses to the border, totaling tens or hundreds as one coupon; one horse was prepaid one thousand cash; the government supplied fodder and grain; continued feeding to the capital; the relevant office sold them and distributed them among the various superintendencies — called coupon horses.
translations.idiomatic: When horses were procured through market purchase, frontier peoples drove horses to the border in groups of tens or hundreds under a single coupon. Each horse received a prepayment of one thousand cash, with fodder supplied by the government for the journey to the capital, where officials sold them and distributed them among the superintendencies. These were called coupon horses.

sentences.zh: 邊州置場，市蕃漢馬團綱，遣殿侍部送赴闕，或就配諸軍，曰省馬。

translations.literal: Border prefectures established markets, purchasing Tangut and Han horses in convoy groups, dispatching palace attendants to escort them to court, or assigning them directly to the various armies — called provincial horses.
translations.idiomatic: Border prefectures established markets to purchase Tangut and Han horses in convoy groups, dispatching palace attendants to escort them to the capital or assigning them directly to the various armies. These were called provincial horses.

sentences.zh: 陝西廣銳、勁勇等軍，相與為社，每市馬，官給直外，社眾復裒金益之，曰馬社。

translations.literal: Armies such as Guangrui and Jinyong in Shaanxi formed mutual societies; whenever horses were purchased, besides the price given by the government, society members pooled money to supplement it — called horse societies.
translations.idiomatic: Armies such as Guangrui and Jinyong in Shaanxi formed mutual societies. Whenever horses were purchased, society members pooled additional funds beyond the government price. These were called horse societies.

sentences.zh: 軍興，籍民馬而市之以給軍，曰括買。

translations.literal: When the army mobilized, civilian horses were registered and purchased to supply the army — called compulsory purchase.
translations.idiomatic: When the army mobilized, civilian horses were registered and purchased to supply military needs. This was called compulsory purchase.

sentences.zh: 宋初，市馬唯河東、陝西、川峽三路，招馬唯吐蕃、回紇、党項、藏牙族，白馬、鼻家、保家、名市族諸蕃。

translations.literal: In early Song, horse markets were only on the Hedong, Shaanxi, and Sichuan Gorges three routes; horse recruitment was only from Tibetans, Uyghurs, Tanguts, Zangya tribes, and various tribes including Baima, Bija, Baojia, and Mingshi.
translations.idiomatic: In early Song, horse markets operated only along the Hedong, Shaanxi, and Sichuan Gorges routes, and horses were recruited only from Tibetans, Uyghurs, Tanguts, the Zangya tribe, and various other tribes including the Baima, Bija, Baojia, and Mingshi peoples.

sentences.zh: 至雍熙、端拱間，河東則麟、府、豐、嵐州、岢嵐、火山軍、唐龍鎮、濁輪砦，陝西則秦、渭、涇、原、儀、延、環、慶、階州、鎮戎、保安軍、制勝關、浩府，河西則靈、綏、銀、夏州，川峽則益、文、黎、雅、戎、茂、夔州、永康軍，京東則登州。

translations.literal: By the Yongxi and Duangong periods, on Hedong: Lin, Fu, Feng, Lan prefectures, Kelan, Huoshan Army, Tanglong Town, Zhuolun Stockade; on Shaanxi: Qin, Wei, Jing, Yuan, Yi, Yan, Huan, Qing, Jie prefectures, Zhenrong, Bao'an Army, Zhisheng Pass, Haofu; on Hexi: Ling, Sui, Yin, Xia prefectures; on Sichuan Gorges: Yi, Wen, Li, Ya, Rong, Mao, Kui prefectures, Yongkang Army; on Jingdong: Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: By the Yongxi and Duangong periods, Hedong markets included Lin, Fu, Feng, and Lan prefectures, Kelan, Huoshan Army, Tanglong Town, and Zhuolun Stockade; Shaanxi markets included Qin, Wei, Jing, Yuan, Yi, Yan, Huan, Qing, and Jie prefectures, Zhenrong, Bao'an Army, Zhisheng Pass, and Haofu; Hexi markets included Ling, Sui, Yin, and Xia prefectures; Sichuan Gorges markets included Yi, Wen, Li, Ya, Rong, Mao, and Kui prefectures and Yongkang Army; and Jingdong had Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 自趙德明據有河南，其收市唯麟、府、涇、原、儀、渭、秦、階、環州、岢嵐、火山、保安、保德軍。

translations.literal: Since Zhao Deming occupied Henan south of the river, collection and marketing were only at Lin, Fu, Jing, Yuan, Yi, Wei, Qin, Jie prefectures, Huanzhou, Kelan, Huoshan, Bao'an, and Baode Army.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhao Deming seized territory south of the Yellow River, horse procurement was limited to Lin and Fu prefectures, Jing, Yuan, Yi, Wei, Qin, and Jie prefectures, Huanzhou, Kelan, Huoshan, Bao'an, and Baode Army.

sentences.zh: 其後置場，則又止環、慶、延、渭、原、秦、階、文州、鎮戎軍而已。

translations.literal: Later when markets were established, they were further limited to only Huan, Qing, Yan, Wei, Yuan, Qin, Jie prefectures, Wenzhou, and Zhenrong Army.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when markets were established, they were further reduced to Huan, Qing, Yan, Wei, Yuan, Qin, and Jie prefectures, Wenzhou, and Zhenrong Army alone.

sentences.zh: 太祖時，歲遣中使詣邊州市馬。

translations.literal: Under Taizu, palace emissaries were sent each year to border prefectures to market horses.
translations.idiomatic: Under Taizu, palace emissaries were dispatched each year to border prefectures to purchase horses.

sentences.zh: 先是，兩河之民入蕃界盜馬入中國。

translations.literal: Previously, people of the two He regions entered Tangut territory to steal horses and bring them into China.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, people from the two He regions had entered Tangut territory to steal horses and bring them into Song territory.

sentences.zh: 官給其直。

translations.literal: The government paid them the price.
translations.idiomatic: The government paid them the purchase price.

sentences.zh: 時方留意撫綏，詔禁之。

translations.literal: At the time the court was attentive to pacification and comfort; it was decreed forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: The court was then focused on pacifying the frontier peoples, and the practice was prohibited by edict.

sentences.zh: 太平興國四年，詔市吏民馬十七萬匹。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, it was decreed to purchase one hundred seventy thousand horses from officials and the people.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo (979), the court ordered the purchase of one hundred seventy thousand horses from officials and civilians.

sentences.zh: 六年，詔內屬戎人驅馬詣闕下者，首領縣次續食，且禁富民無得私市。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, it was decreed that when affiliated frontier peoples drove horses to the court, tribal leaders received continued provisions at each county stop, and wealthy commoners were forbidden from private purchase.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, when affiliated frontier peoples drove horses to the capital, tribal leaders were supplied with provisions at each county along the route, and wealthy civilians were forbidden from making private purchases.

sentences.zh: 十二月，詔：「蕃部鬻馬，官取良而棄弩，又禁其私市，歲入數既不充，且無以懷遠人。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, it was decreed: "When frontier tribes sell horses, the government takes the good and rejects the inferior; private purchase is also forbidden — annual intake is insufficient, and there is no means to win over distant peoples.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, an edict declared: "When frontier tribes sell horses, the government selects only the finest and rejects the inferior, while private purchase is also forbidden. Annual intake falls short, and there is no way to win the goodwill of distant peoples.

sentences.zh: 自今委長吏謹視馬之良駑，駑即印識之，許民私市焉。」

translations.literal: From now appoint chief local officials to carefully inspect horses' quality; inferior ones shall be marked with a seal, and the people are permitted to purchase them privately."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, local officials are to carefully assess each horse's quality. Inferior horses shall be marked with an official seal, and private purchase by civilians shall be permitted."

sentences.zh: 先是，以銅錢給諸蕃馬直。

translations.literal: Previously, copper cash was used to pay the various tribes for horses.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, the various tribes had been paid for horses in copper cash.

sentences.zh: 八年，有司言戎人得錢，銷鑄為器，乃以布帛茶及他物易之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the relevant offices said frontier peoples upon receiving cash melted and cast it into utensils; thereupon cloth, silk, tea, and other goods were used to exchange for horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, officials reported that frontier peoples were melting cash to cast utensils, so payment was switched to cloth, silk, tea, and other goods.

sentences.zh: 天禧中，宰相向敏中言國馬倍於先朝，廣費芻粟。

translations.literal: During Tianxi, Chief Councillor Xiang Minzhong said state horses were double those of the previous dynasty, widely expending fodder and grain.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tianxi era, Chief Councillor Xiang Minzhong reported that state horses had doubled since the previous dynasty, consuming vast amounts of fodder and grain.

sentences.zh: 乃詔以十三歲以上配軍馬估直出賣。

translations.literal: Thereupon it was decreed that army-assigned horses thirteen years and older be appraised and sold off.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered army-assigned horses thirteen years and older to be appraised and sold.

sentences.zh: 先是市馬以三歲已上、十三歲已下為率。

translations.literal: Previously, horse purchases took those three years and older and thirteen years and younger as the standard.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, purchased horses had to be between three and thirteen years of age.

sentences.zh: 天聖中，詔市四歲已上、十歲已下。

translations.literal: During Tiansheng, it was decreed to purchase those four years and older and ten years and younger.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tiansheng era, purchases were limited to horses between four and ten years of age.

sentences.zh: 既而所市不足，群牧司以為言，乃詔入券並省馬市三歲已上、十二歲已下。

translations.literal: Subsequently purchases were insufficient; the Herd Pasture Bureau memorialized, and it was decreed that coupon horses and provincial horses entering be purchased from three years and older to twelve years and younger.
translations.idiomatic: When purchases still fell short, the Herd Pasture Bureau petitioned the throne, and coupon horses and provincial horses were ordered purchased between three and twelve years of age.

sentences.zh: 明年，詔府州、岢嵐軍自今省馬三歲、四歲者不以等第，五歲已上十二歲已下、骨格良善行者，悉許綱送估馬司，餘非上京省馬並送并州揀馬司。

translations.literal: The next year, it was decreed that at Fuzhou and Kelan Army, from now on provincial horses three and four years old would not be graded by rank; those five years and older to twelve years and younger with good bone structure and gait were all permitted convoy delivery to the Horse Appraisal Office; the rest, not provincial horses sent to the capital, were all sent to the Bingzhou Horse Selection Office.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, Fuzhou and Kelan Army were ordered that three- and four-year-old provincial horses would no longer be graded by rank. Horses five to twelve years old with sound bone structure and gait could be convoyed to the Horse Appraisal Office; all others not bound for the capital were sent to the Bingzhou Horse Selection Office.

sentences.zh: 景祐元年，御史中丞韓億言：「蕃都以馬抵永康軍中賣，所得至少，徒使羌人知蜀山川道路，非計之得。」

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingyou, Censor-in-Chief Han Yi said: "Tribal chiefs bring horses to sell at Yongkang Army; the proceeds are minimal, yet it only lets the Qiang learn the mountains, rivers, and roads of Shu — this is not a good plan."
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jingyou (1034), Censor-in-Chief Han Yi argued: "Tribal chiefs bring horses to sell at Yongkang Army for minimal profit, yet it only teaches the Qiang the mountains, rivers, and roads of Shu. This is a poor strategy."

sentences.zh: 乃詔罷之。

translations.literal: Thereupon it was decreed abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The market was accordingly abolished.

sentences.zh: 四年，群牧司奏河北諸軍闕馬，請製等杖六，付天雄軍、真定府、定、瀛、貝、滄州，市上生馬十二歲以下，視等第給直。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the Herd Pasture Bureau memorialized that various armies in Hebei lacked horses and requested six measuring rods be made and issued to Tianxiong Army, Zhending Prefecture, Ding, Ying, Bei, and Cang prefectures to purchase locally raised horses twelve years and younger, paying prices according to grade.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, the Herd Pasture Bureau reported that Hebei armies lacked horses and requested six measuring rods be issued to Tianxiong Army, Zhending Prefecture, and Ding, Ying, Bei, and Cang prefectures to purchase locally raised horses twelve years and younger at graded prices.

sentences.zh: 馬自四尺七寸至四尺二寸，凡六等。

translations.literal: Horses from four chi seven cun to four chi two cun — six grades in all.
translations.idiomatic: Horses ranged from four chi seven cun to four chi two cun in height, divided into six grades.

sentences.zh: 其直自二萬五千四百五十至萬六千五百五十，課自萬三千四百五十至八千九百五十九，六等，取備邊兵戶絕錢充直。

translations.literal: Their prices ranged from twenty-five thousand four hundred fifty to sixteen thousand five hundred fifty; levies ranged from thirteen thousand four hundred fifty to eight thousand nine hundred fifty-nine — six grades — drawn from frontier defense military household shortfall funds to pay prices.
translations.idiomatic: Prices ranged from twenty-five thousand four hundred fifty to sixteen thousand five hundred fifty cash, with levies from thirteen thousand four hundred fifty to eight thousand nine hundred fifty-nine across six grades, funded from frontier defense military household shortfall accounts.

sentences.zh: 以第一等送京師，餘就配諸軍。

translations.literal: First-grade horses were sent to the capital; the rest were assigned on the spot to the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: First-grade horses were sent to the capital; the rest were assigned locally to the various armies.

sentences.zh: 康定初，陝西用兵，馬不足。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kangding, Shaanxi was at war and horses were insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Kangding era, Shaanxi was at war and horses were in short supply.

sentences.zh: 詔京畿、京東西、淮南、陝西路括市戰馬，馬四尺六寸至四尺二寸，其直自五十千至二十千，凡五等。

translations.literal: It was decreed that the capital region, eastern and western Jing circuits, Huainan, and Shaanxi circuit compulsorily purchase war horses; horses from four chi six cun to four chi two cun, prices from fifty thousand to twenty thousand — five grades in all.
translations.idiomatic: The capital region, eastern and western Jing circuits, Huainan, and Shaanxi circuit were ordered to compulsorily purchase war horses between four chi six cun and four chi two cun in height, at prices from fifty thousand to twenty thousand cash across five grades.

sentences.zh: 宰臣、樞密使聽畜馬七，參知政事、樞密副使五，尚書、學士至知雜、閣門使已上三，升朝官閣門祗候已上一，餘命官至諸司職員、寺觀主首皆一。

translations.literal: Chief councillors and Bureau of Military Affairs directors were permitted seven horses; vice grand councillors and vice directors of military affairs five; from Ministers and Academicians down to miscellaneous affairs officials and gate commissioners three and above; from court officials and gate attendants upward one; the rest by rank down to various office functionaries and temple and monastery heads — all one.
translations.idiomatic: Chief councillors and Bureau of Military Affairs directors could keep seven horses; vice grand councillors and vice directors five; Ministers, Academicians, and officials down to gate commissioners three; court officials and gate attendants one; and all others by rank down to office functionaries and temple and monastery heads one each.

sentences.zh: 節度使至刺史，殿前馬步軍都指揮至軍頭司散員、副兵馬使皆勿括。

translations.literal: From military governors to prefects, from Palace Front and Rear Cavalry and Infantry commanders to Army Head Office irregulars and deputy horse commanders — all were exempt from compulsory purchase.
translations.idiomatic: Military governors, prefects, Palace Front and Rear Cavalry and Infantry commanders, Army Head Office irregulars, and deputy horse commanders were all exempt.

sentences.zh: 並邊七州軍免。

translations.literal: Seven border prefectures and armies were also exempt.
translations.idiomatic: Seven border prefectures and garrisons were also exempt.

sentences.zh: 出內庫珠償民馬直。

translations.literal: Pearls from the inner treasury were issued to compensate the people for horse prices.
translations.idiomatic: Pearls from the inner treasury were issued to compensate civilians for their horses.

sentences.zh: 又禁邊臣私市，闕者官給。

translations.literal: Private purchase by frontier officials was also forbidden; shortages were supplied by the government.
translations.idiomatic: Private purchases by frontier officials were also prohibited; shortages were to be supplied by the government.

sentences.zh: 二年，詔：「河北州軍置場市馬，雖除等樣，如聞所得不廣，宜加增直。

translations.literal: In the second year, it was decreed: "Hebei prefectures and armies have established markets to purchase horses; although grades and standards are set, it is heard that acquisitions are not broad — prices should be increased.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, an edict declared: "Although Hebei prefectures and armies have established horse markets with set grades and standards, acquisitions have been limited. Prices should be raised.

sentences.zh: 第一等二萬八千，第二等二萬六千，第三等二萬四千，第四等以下及牝馬即依舊直。

translations.literal: First grade twenty-eight thousand, second grade twenty-six thousand, third grade twenty-four thousand; fourth grade and below and brood mares follow the old prices.
translations.idiomatic: First grade twenty-eight thousand, second grade twenty-six thousand, third grade twenty-four thousand; fourth grade and below and brood mares would remain at the old prices.

sentences.zh: 仍自第二等以下遞減一寸。」

translations.literal: From second grade downward, each grade decreases by one cun."
translations.idiomatic: From second grade downward, each grade would decrease by one cun in height requirement."

sentences.zh: 慶曆四年，詔：「河北點印民間馬，凡收市外，見餘二萬七百，除坊郭戶三等、鄉村三等已上養飼如舊，餘點印者悉集揀市。」

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qingli, it was decreed: "Hebei civilian horses are branded; besides those purchased, there remain twenty thousand seven hundred. Excepting urban third-rank households and rural third-rank and above who keep horses as before, all others branded shall be gathered for selective purchase."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Qingli (1044), an edict ordered branding of civilian horses in Hebei. Beyond those already purchased, twenty thousand seven hundred remained. Urban third-rank households and rural households of third rank and above could keep horses as before; all others branded were to be gathered for selective purchase."

sentences.zh: 五年，出內藏庫絹二十萬，市馬於秦州、岢嵐軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, two hundred thousand bolts of silk from the inner treasury were issued to purchase horses at Qinzhou and Kelan Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, two hundred thousand bolts of silk from the inner treasury were allocated to purchase horses at Qinzhou and Kelan Army.

sentences.zh: 六年，詔陝西、河東社馬死者，本營鬻錢以助馬直。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, it was decreed that when society horses died in Shaanxi and Hedong, the home camp should sell goods to raise money to help pay horse prices.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, when society horses died in Shaanxi and Hedong, home camps were ordered to raise funds through sales to help cover replacement horse costs.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐元年，詔三司出絹三萬，市馬於秦州以給河東軍。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiayou, it was decreed that the State Finance Commission issue thirty thousand bolts of silk to purchase horses at Qinzhou to supply Hedong armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiayou (1056), the State Finance Commission was ordered to allocate thirty thousand bolts of silk to purchase horses at Qinzhou for Hedong armies.

sentences.zh: 五年，薛向言：「秦州券馬至京師，給直並路費，一馬計錢數萬。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Xue Xiang said: "Coupon horses from Qinzhou reach the capital; payment plus travel expenses — one horse costs tens of thousands in cash.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Xue Xiang reported: "When coupon horses from Qinzhou reach the capital, payment plus travel expenses cost tens of thousands of cash per horse.

sentences.zh: 請於原、渭州、德順軍置場收市，給以解鹽交引，即不耗度支縑錢。

translations.literal: I request markets be established at Yuan and Weizhou and Deshun Army for collection and purchase, paying with jie-salt exchange certificates — thus not depleting the Department of Revenue's silk and cash.
translations.idiomatic: I request that markets be established at Yuan and Weizhou and Deshun Army for local purchase, paying with jie-salt exchange certificates so as not to drain the Department of Revenue's silk and cash reserves.

sentences.zh: 其券馬姑存，以來遠人。

translations.literal: Coupon horses should temporarily remain, to attract distant peoples.
translations.idiomatic: The coupon horse system should be retained for now to attract distant peoples.

sentences.zh: 歲可別得良馬八千，以三千給沿邊軍騎，五千入群牧司。」

translations.literal: Each year eight thousand fine horses could additionally be obtained — three thousand given to frontier cavalry, five thousand entering the Herd Pasture Bureau."
translations.idiomatic: Each year an additional eight thousand fine horses could be obtained — three thousand for frontier cavalry and five thousand for the Herd Pasture Bureau."

sentences.zh: 七年，陝西提舉買馬監牧司奏：「舊制，秦州蕃漢人月募得良馬二百至京師，給彩絹、銀碗、腰帶、錦襖子，蕃官、回紇隱藏不引至者，並以漢法論罪。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, the Shaanxi Horse Purchase and Pasture Superintendency memorialized: "Under the old system, Tangut and Han at Qinzhou monthly recruited two hundred fine horses to the capital, given colored silk, silver bowls, belts, and brocade jackets. Tribal officials and Uyghurs who concealed horses and did not bring them forward were all punished under Han law.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, the Shaanxi Horse Purchase and Pasture Superintendency reported: "Under the old system, Tangut and Han at Qinzhou delivered two hundred fine horses monthly to the capital, receiving colored silk, silver bowls, belts, and brocade jackets. Tribal officials and Uyghurs who concealed horses were punished under Song law.

sentences.zh: 歲募及二千，給賞物外，蕃都補蕃官，蕃官轉資，回紇百姓加等給賞。

translations.literal: When annual recruitment reached two thousand, besides reward goods, tribal chiefs were appointed tribal officials, tribal officials received rank advancement, and Uyghur commoners received elevated-grade rewards.
translations.idiomatic: When annual recruitment reached two thousand, beyond standard rewards tribal chiefs were appointed tribal officials, tribal officials received rank advancement, and Uyghur commoners received elevated rewards.

sentences.zh: 今原、渭、德順軍置場市馬，請如秦州例施行。」

translations.literal: Now that markets for horse purchase are established at Yuan, Wei, and Deshun armies, I request the Qinzhou precedent be applied."
translations.idiomatic: Now that horse markets have been established at Yuan, Wei, and Deshun armies, I request the Qinzhou precedent be applied."

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: The decree approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 先是，詔議買馬利害。

translations.literal: Previously, it was decreed to discuss the advantages and disadvantages of horse purchase.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, the court had ordered a review of the advantages and disadvantages of horse purchase.

sentences.zh: 吳奎等議於秦州古渭、永寧砦及原州、德順軍各令置場，京師歲支銀四萬兩、紬絹七萬五千匹充馬直，不足，以解鹽鈔並雜支錢給之。

translations.literal: Wu Kui and others proposed establishing markets at each of Guwei and Yongning stockades at Qinzhou and at Yuanzhou and Deshun Army; the capital would annually disburse forty thousand taels of silver and seventy-five thousand bolts of silk and gauze for horse prices; if insufficient, jie-salt certificates and miscellaneous disbursement funds would supplement payment.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Kui and others proposed establishing markets at Guwei and Yongning stockades in Qinzhou and at Yuanzhou and Deshun Army. The capital would annually allocate forty thousand taels of silver and seventy-five thousand bolts of silk and gauze for horse purchases, supplemented if needed by jie-salt certificates and miscellaneous funds.

sentences.zh: 詔行之。

translations.literal: The decree ordered it implemented.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved and implemented.

sentences.zh: 八年，宰臣韓琦言：「秦州永寧砦舊以鈔市馬，自修古渭砦，在永寧之西，而蕃漢多互市其間，因置買馬場，凡歲用緡錢十餘萬，蕩然流入虜中，實耗國用。」

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Chief Councillor Han Qi said: "Yongning Stockade at Qinzhou formerly used certificates to market horses. Since Guwei Stockade was built west of Yongning and Tangut and Han frequently traded there, a horse market was established — annually more than one hundred thousand strings of cash flowed entirely into the enemy territory, truly depleting state resources."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Chief Councillor Han Qi reported: "Yongning Stockade at Qinzhou formerly used certificates for horse trade. Since Guwei Stockade was built west of Yongning and became a hub for Tangut-Han trade, a horse market was established there — annually more than one hundred thousand strings of cash flowed into enemy territory, seriously depleting state resources."

sentences.zh: 詔復置場永寧，罷古渭砦中場。

translations.literal: It was decreed to restore the market at Yongning and abolish the market within Guwei Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: The market was restored at Yongning and the market within Guwei Stockade was abolished.

sentences.zh: 蕃都馬至，徑鬻於秦州。

translations.literal: When tribal chiefs' horses arrived, they were sold directly at Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When tribal chiefs brought horses, they were sold directly at Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 大抵國初市馬，歲僅得五千餘匹。

translations.literal: In general, in the early dynasty horse purchases annually obtained only more than five thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In general, early Song horse purchases yielded only about five thousand horses per year.

sentences.zh: 天聖中，蕃部省馬至三萬四千九百餘匹。

translations.literal: During Tiansheng, provincial horses from tribal departments reached more than thirty-four thousand nine hundred.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tiansheng era, provincial horses from tribal departments reached more than thirty-four thousand nine hundred.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐以前，原、渭、德順凡三歲市馬至萬七千一百匹，秦州券馬歲至萬五千匹。

translations.literal: Before Jiayou, at Yuan, Wei, and Deshun over three years horse purchases reached seventeen thousand one hundred; Qinzhou coupon horses annually reached fifteen thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Before Jiayou, markets at Yuan, Wei, and Deshun purchased seventeen thousand one hundred horses over three years, while Qinzhou coupon horses averaged fifteen thousand per year.

sentences.zh: 凡牧地，自畿甸及近郡，使擇水草善地而標占之。

translations.literal: As for pasture lands, from the capital district and nearby prefectures, envoys selected good lands with water and grass and marked and occupied them.
translations.idiomatic: Pasture lands in the capital district and nearby prefectures were selected for good water and grass and marked for official use.

sentences.zh: 淳化、景德間，內外坊、監總六萬八千頃，諸軍班又三萬九百頃不預焉。

translations.literal: Between Chunhua and Jingde, inner and outer wards and superintendencies totaled sixty-eight thousand qing; various army units had another thirty thousand nine hundred qing not included.
translations.idiomatic: Between the Chunhua and Jingde eras, inner and outer wards and superintendencies totaled sixty-eight thousand qing, not counting another thirty thousand nine hundred qing held by various army units.

sentences.zh: 歲久官失其籍，界堠不明，廢置不常，而淪於侵冒者多矣。

translations.literal: Over years officials lost the registers, boundary markers were unclear, abolition and establishment were irregular, and much fell to encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: Over time officials lost the land registers, boundary markers grew unclear, and abolitions and reestablishments were frequent. Much land fell to encroachment.

sentences.zh: 淳化二年十二月，通利軍上《十牧草地圖》，上慮侵民田，遣中使檢視疆理。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the second year of Chunhua, Tongli Army submitted the "Ten Pasture Lands Map"; the emperor feared encroachment on civilian fields and dispatched a palace emissary to inspect boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second year of Chunhua (991), Tongli Army submitted the "Ten Pasture Lands Map." Fearing encroachment on civilian fields, the emperor dispatched a palace emissary to inspect the boundaries.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐中，韓琦請括諸監牧地，留牧外，聽下戶耕佃。

translations.literal: During Jiayou, Han Qi requested surveying all superintendency pasture lands; beyond what was needed for pasture, lower-rank households were permitted to farm and tenant.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiayou era, Han Qi requested a survey of all superintendency pasture lands, allowing lower-rank households to farm and tenant land beyond grazing needs.

sentences.zh: 遣都官員外郎高訪等括河北，得閑田三千三百五十頃募佃，歲約得穀十一萬七千八百石，絹三千二百五十匹，草十六萬一千二百束。

translations.literal: Director of Punishments Outer Section Member Gao Fang and others were dispatched to survey Hebei, obtaining three thousand three hundred fifty qing of idle land for tenant recruitment; annually approximately one hundred seventeen thousand eight hundred shi of grain, three thousand two hundred fifty bolts of silk, and one hundred sixty-one thousand two hundred bundles of hay were obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Fang, Outer Section Member of the Director of Punishments, and others surveyed Hebei and found three thousand three hundred fifty qing of idle land for tenant farming, yielding annually about one hundred seventeen thousand eight hundred shi of grain, three thousand two hundred fifty bolts of silk, and one hundred sixty-one thousand two hundred bundles of hay.

sentences.zh: 群牧司言：「諸監牧地間有水旱，每監牧放外，歲刈白草數萬束，以備冬飼。

translations.literal: The Herd Pasture Bureau said: "Among superintendency pasture lands there are floods and droughts; besides pasture at each superintendency, tens of thousands of bundles of white grass are mowed annually to prepare for winter feeding.
translations.idiomatic: The Herd Pasture Bureau reported: "Superintendency pasture lands are subject to flood and drought. Beyond active grazing, each superintendency mows tens of thousands of bundles of white grass annually for winter feeding.

sentences.zh: 今悉賦民，異時監馬增多，及有水旱，無以轉徙牧放。」

translations.literal: Now all is assigned to the people; in future when superintendency horses increase, and when there are floods and droughts, there will be no means to transfer and relocate for pasture."
translations.idiomatic: If all this land is assigned to civilians, future herd increases and flood or drought will leave no land for relocation and grazing."

sentences.zh: 詔遣左右廂提點官相度，除先被侵冒已根括出地權給租佃，餘委群牧司審度存留，有閑土即募耕佃。

translations.literal: It was decreed that Left and Right Wing inspector officials be dispatched to assess; excepting land previously encroached upon and already recovered, temporarily given for rent and tenancy, the rest was entrusted to the Herd Pasture Bureau to review and retain; where idle land existed, tenant farming was recruited.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Wing inspectors were dispatched to assess the situation. Land previously encroached upon and recovered could be temporarily rented out; the Herd Pasture Bureau would review the rest for retention, with idle land open to tenant farming.

sentences.zh: 五年，群牧司言：「凡牧一馬，往來踐食，占地五十畝。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the Herd Pasture Bureau said: "For each horse pastured, coming and going to graze, fifty mu of land is occupied.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, the Herd Pasture Bureau reported: "Each pastured horse, moving to and fro while grazing, requires fifty mu of land.

sentences.zh: 諸監既無餘地，難以募耕，請存留如故。

translations.literal: The various superintendencies already have no surplus land — difficult to recruit tenant farming; I request retention as before.
translations.idiomatic: The superintendencies already have no surplus land for tenant farming. I request that pasture lands be retained as before.

sentences.zh: 廣平廢監先賦民者，亦乞取還。」

translations.literal: Land from the abolished Guangping superintendency previously assigned to the people — I also request it be taken back."
translations.idiomatic: Land from the abolished Guangping superintendency previously assigned to civilians should also be reclaimed."

sentences.zh: 乃詔：「河北、京東牧監帳管草地，自今毋得縱人請射，犯者論以違制。」

translations.literal: Thereupon it was decreed: "Pasture lands under the accounts of Hebei and Jingdong superintendencies — from now on people must not be permitted to apply for and occupy them; violators shall be prosecuted for violating regulations."
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Pasture lands under Hebei and Jingdong superintendencies must no longer be open to private occupation. Violators will be prosecuted for violating regulations."

sentences.zh: 群牧使歐陽修言：「唐之牧地，西起隴右金城、平涼、天水，外暨河曲之野，內則岐、幽、涇、寧，東接銀、夏，又東至於樓煩。

translations.literal: Herd Pasture Commissioner Ouyang Xiu said: "Tang pasture lands began in the west at Longyou, Jincheng, Pingliang, and Tianshui, outward reaching the wilds of the river bend; inward including Qi, You, Jing, and Ning; east connecting Yin and Xia; further east reaching Loufan.
translations.idiomatic: Herd Pasture Commissioner Ouyang Xiu observed: "Tang pasture lands extended west from Longyou, Jincheng, Pingliang, and Tianshui to the wilds beyond the river bend; inward through Qi, You, Jing, and Ning; east through Yin and Xia to Loufan.

sentences.zh: 今則沒入蕃界，淪於侵佃，不可復得。

translations.literal: Now they have sunk into Tangut territory and fallen to encroachment and tenancy — cannot be recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Today they have sunk into Tangut territory and fallen to encroachment and private farming, beyond recovery.

sentences.zh: 惟河東嵐、石之間，山荒甚多，汾河之側，草地亦廣，其間水草最宜牧養，此唐樓煩監地。

translations.literal: Only between Lan and Shi in Hedong, mountains are largely barren; beside the Fen River, pasture lands are also broad; among them water and grass are most suitable for pasture rearing — this is Tang's Loufan Superintendency land.
translations.idiomatic: Only between Lan and Shi in Hedong, where mountains are largely barren and pasture lands beside the Fen River are broad, is the water and grass most suitable for grazing. This was the land of Tang's Loufan Superintendency.

sentences.zh: 跡此推之，則樓煩、元池、天池三監舊地，尚冀可得。

translations.literal: Tracing this and extrapolating, the old lands of the three superintendencies Loufan, Yuanchi, and Tianchi might still be obtainable.
translations.idiomatic: By this reasoning, the old lands of the Loufan, Yuanchi, and Tianchi superintendencies might still be recoverable.

sentences.zh: 臣往年出使，嘗行威勝以東及遼州、平定軍，其地率多閑曠。

translations.literal: When I went on mission in previous years, I traveled east of Weisheng and to Liaozhou and Pingding Army — the lands were mostly idle and open.
translations.idiomatic: On a mission in previous years, I traveled east of Weisheng and to Liaozhou and Pingding Army and found the land mostly idle and open.

sentences.zh: 河東一路，水草甚佳，地勢高寒，必宜馬性。

translations.literal: The entire Hedong circuit has excellent water and grass; the terrain is high and cold — surely suited to horses' nature.
translations.idiomatic: The entire Hedong circuit has excellent water and grass; its high, cold terrain is well suited to horses.

sentences.zh: 又京西唐、汝之間，荒地亦廣。

translations.literal: Also between Tang and Ru in western Jing, wasteland is also broad.
translations.idiomatic: Between Tang and Ru in western Jing, wasteland is also extensive.

sentences.zh: 請下河東、京西轉運司遣官審度，若可興置監牧，則河北諸監，尋可廢罷。」

translations.literal: I request the Hedong and western Jing transport commissions be ordered to dispatch officials to assess; if pasture superintendencies can be established, then the various Hebei superintendencies can soon be abolished."
translations.idiomatic: I request that the Hedong and western Jing transport commissions dispatch officials to assess whether new pasture superintendencies can be established, in which case the Hebei superintendencies could soon be abolished."

sentences.zh: 治平末，牧地總五萬五千，河南六監三萬二千，而河北六監則二萬三千。

translations.literal: At the end of Zhiping, pasture lands totaled fifty-five thousand; the six superintendencies south of the Yellow River had thirty-two thousand, while the six superintendencies in Hebei had twenty-three thousand.
translations.idiomatic: By the end of the Zhiping era, pasture lands totaled fifty-five thousand qing: thirty-two thousand for the six superintendencies south of the Yellow River and twenty-three thousand for the six in Hebei.

sentences.zh: 凡支配，騏驥院、估馬司以當配軍及新收馬閱於便殿，數毋過二百。

translations.literal: As for allocation, the Fine Steed courtyards and Horse Appraisal Office inspected horses due for army assignment and newly received horses at the informal hall; the number must not exceed two hundred.
translations.idiomatic: For allocation, the Fine Steed courtyards and Horse Appraisal Office inspected horses due for army assignment and newly received horses at the informal hall, with no more than two hundred presented at a time.

sentences.zh: 凡配軍，視其奉錢之數，馬自四尺六寸至四尺三寸，奉錢自一千至三百，為四等，差次給之，至五月權止。

translations.literal: For army assignment, according to salary amounts: horses from four chi six cun to four chi three cun; salaries from one thousand to three hundred — four grades, given in descending order, until the fifth month when it temporarily ceased.
translations.idiomatic: For army assignment, horses from four chi six cun to four chi three cun were matched to soldiers with salaries from one thousand to three hundred cash in four grades, allocated in descending order until the fifth month when the program temporarily ceased.

sentences.zh: 外州軍士闕馬，先奏稟乃給。

translations.literal: When soldiers in outer prefectures and armies lacked horses, they first memorialized for approval before receiving them.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers in outer prefectures and armies who lacked horses had to petition for approval before receiving them.

sentences.zh: 荊湖路歸遠、雄武軍士，配以在所土產馬。

translations.literal: Soldiers of Guiyuan and Xiongwu armies on the Jinghu circuit were assigned locally produced horses.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers of the Guiyuan and Xiongwu armies on the Jinghu circuit were assigned locally bred horses.

sentences.zh: 凡闕馬軍士，以分數配填。

translations.literal: For all soldiers lacking horses, allocation was by fractional quota.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers lacking horses were supplied according to fractional quotas.

sentences.zh: 慶曆四年，詔陝西、河北、河東填五分，餘路填四分。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qingli, it was decreed that Shaanxi, Hebei, and Hedong fill five tenths; other circuits fill four tenths.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Qingli (1044), Shaanxi, Hebei, and Hedong were allotted five tenths of available horses; other circuits four tenths.

sentences.zh: 他州軍、府界巡檢兵校聽自市，官償其直，毋過三十千。

translations.literal: Military officers of other prefectures, armies, and capital-district patrol units were permitted to purchase on their own; the government compensated the price, not exceeding thirty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Military officers in other prefectures, armies, and capital-district patrol units could purchase horses themselves, with government reimbursement up to thirty thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 是歲，詔諸路以馬給軍士，比試武技，優者先給，比試兩給；

translations.literal: That year, it was decreed that various circuits give horses to soldiers; those who tested martial skills and excelled received horses first; those who tested twice received two;
translations.idiomatic: That year, circuits were ordered to supply horses to soldiers based on martial skill tests: top performers received horses first, and those who tested twice could receive two;

sentences.zh: 闕馬十匹以下全給，十匹以上如舊數支。

translations.literal: shortages of ten horses or fewer were fully supplied; ten or more followed the old quota disbursement.
translations.idiomatic: shortages of ten horses or fewer were fully supplied; larger shortages followed the old quota system.

sentences.zh: 寶元元年，詔群臣例賜馬者，宰相至樞密直學士，使相至正任刺史，並皇族緣姻事當賜者，如舊制；

translations.literal: In the first year of Baoyuan, it was decreed that for ministers customarily bestowed horses — from chief councillors to Direct Academicians of Military Affairs, from envoy-governors to regular prefects, and imperial clansmen and affinal relatives due gifts — follow the old system;
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Baoyuan (1038), ministers customarily granted horses — from chief councillors to Direct Academicians of Military Affairs, from envoy-governors to regular prefects, and imperial clansmen and affinal relatives due gifts — would continue under the old system;

sentences.zh: 餘給以馬直，少卿監已上三十五千，內殿承制已下二十三千。

translations.literal: the rest were given horse prices — Vice Ministers and above thirty-five thousand, Inner Hall Assistant Commandants and below twenty-three thousand.
translations.idiomatic: all others would receive cash in lieu: Vice Ministers and above thirty-five thousand, Inner Hall Assistant Commandants and below twenty-three thousand.

sentences.zh: 凡群臣假官馬進奉者，置籍報左藏庫，償直四十千，其後多負不償。

translations.literal: For all ministers who borrowed official horses for tribute presentation, registers were kept and reported to the Left Treasury; compensation was forty thousand — afterward many owed and did not repay.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers who borrowed official horses for tribute presentation were registered with the Left Treasury at a compensation rate of forty thousand cash, but many later failed to repay.

sentences.zh: 乃詔借馬者先輸直，久逋不償者克其奉料。

translations.literal: Thereupon it was decreed that horse borrowers pay the price first; those long in arrears without repayment had their salaries deducted.
translations.idiomatic: Borrowers were then required to pay upfront, and those long in arrears had their salaries deducted.

sentences.zh: 熙寧以來，有保馬、戶馬，其後又變為給地牧馬。

translations.literal: Since Xining, there have been guaranteed horses and household horses; afterward these changed again to land-grant pasture horses.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Xining era, there have been guaranteed horses and household horses, which later evolved into land-grant pasture horses.

sentences.zh: 神宗嘗患馬政不善，謂樞密使文彥博曰：「群牧官非人，無以責成效。

translations.literal: Emperor Shenzong once grieved that horse administration was poor and said to Bureau of Military Affairs Director Wen Yanbo: "Herd pasture officials are not the right people — there is no means to demand results.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shenzong once lamented poor horse administration and told Bureau of Military Affairs Director Wen Yanbo: "The wrong people hold herd pasture offices — there is no way to demand results.

sentences.zh: 其令中書擇使，卿舉判官，冀國馬蕃息，以給戰騎。」

translations.literal: Order the Secretariat to select commissioners; you recommend administrative judges — hoping state horses multiply and supply war cavalry."
translations.idiomatic: Have the Secretariat select commissioners and you recommend administrative judges, so that state horses may multiply and supply war cavalry."

sentences.zh: 於是以比部員外郎崔台符權群牧判官，又命群牧判官劉航及台符刪定《群牧敕令》，以唐制參本朝故事而奏決焉。

translations.literal: Thereupon Bi Section Outer Section Member Cui Taifu was made acting Herd Pasture administrative judge; Herd Pasture administrative judge Liu Hang and Taifu were also ordered to revise the Herd Pasture Edicts and Commands, referencing Tang institutions against Song precedents and memorializing for decision.
translations.idiomatic: Bi Section Outer Section Member Cui Taifu was appointed acting Herd Pasture administrative judge, and Liu Hang and Taifu were ordered to revise the Herd Pasture Edicts and Commands, drawing on Tang institutions and Song precedents for imperial approval.

sentences.zh: 熙寧元年，又手詔彥博等曰：「今諸州守貳雖同領群牧，而未嘗親蒞職事，其議更制，應監牧、郡守貳並朝廷選授，與坊、監使臣皆第其能否，制賞罰而升黜之，宜立法以聞。」

translations.literal: In the first year of Xining, an imperial handwritten edict to Yanbo and others said: "Now various prefectures' chief and deputy officials although jointly oversee herd pasture, have never personally attended to duties. Discuss reform: pasture superintendencies and prefectural chiefs and deputies should all be selected and appointed by the court; together with ward and superintendency commissioners, grade their ability, establish rewards and punishments for promotion and demotion — establish laws and report."
