translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xining (1068), the emperor wrote to Yanbo and others: "Although prefectural chiefs and deputies nominally oversee herd pasture, they never attend to it personally. Discuss reform: superintendency and prefectural officials should all be court-appointed; together with ward and superintendency commissioners, their performance should be graded with rewards, punishments, and promotions — draft laws and report."

sentences.zh: 又手詔曰：「方今馬政不修，官吏無著效，豈任不久而才不盡歟？

translations.literal: Another handwritten edict said: "At present horse administration is not maintained; officials show no results — is it because terms are short and talent is not fully employed?
translations.idiomatic: Another handwritten edict asked: "Horse administration is in disrepair and officials produce no results. Is it because terms are too short for talent to be fully employed?

sentences.zh: 是何監牧之多，官吏之眾，而乏才之甚也！

translations.literal: How is it that superintendencies are so many, officials so numerous, yet talent is so lacking!
translations.idiomatic: How can there be so many superintendencies and so many officials, yet so little talent!

sentences.zh: 昔唐用張萬歲三世典群牧，恩信行乎下，故馬政修舉，後世稱為能吏。

translations.literal: Formerly Tang employed Zhang Wansui for three generations to manage herd pasture; grace and trust prevailed below, so horse administration was well maintained — later ages called him a capable official.
translations.idiomatic: Tang employed Zhang Wansui's family for three generations to manage herd pasture; grace and trust prevailed throughout the ranks, and horse administration flourished. Later ages hailed him as a model official.

sentences.zh: 今上自提總官屬，下至坊、監使臣，既非銓擇，而遷徙迅速，謂之『假道』，欲使官宿其業而盡其能，不可得也。

translations.literal: Now from supervising officials at the top down to ward and superintendency commissioners, since they are not selected through examination and transfers are rapid — called 'passing through' — wishing officials to lodge in their profession and fully employ their ability is impossible.
translations.idiomatic: Today, from supervising officials down to ward and superintendency commissioners, since none are carefully selected and transfers are rapid — mere 'passing through' — it is impossible to expect officials to master their duties and fully employ their abilities.

sentences.zh: 為今之計者，當簡其勞能，進之以序。

translations.literal: For today's plan, labor and ability should be selected, advancement should follow order.
translations.idiomatic: The solution is to select officials for merit and ability and advance them in proper sequence.

sentences.zh: 自坊、監而上至於群牧都監，皆課其功而第進之，以為任事者勸焉。」

translations.literal: From wards and superintendencies upward to the Herd Pasture chief superintendent, all should have their achievements assessed and be graded for advancement, to encourage those who undertake duties."
translations.idiomatic: From wards and superintendencies up to the Herd Pasture chief superintendent, all should have their achievements assessed and be promoted by grade, to encourage diligent service."

sentences.zh: 於是，樞密副使邵亢請以牧馬餘田修稼政，以資牧養之利。

translations.literal: Thereupon, Vice Director of Military Affairs Shao Kang requested using surplus pasture farmland to develop agricultural policy, to fund pasture-rearing benefits.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director of Military Affairs Shao Kang then proposed developing surplus pasture farmland to support grazing operations.

sentences.zh: 而群牧司言：「馬監草地四萬八千餘頃，今以五萬馬為率，一馬占地五十畝，大名、廣平四監餘田無幾，宜且仍舊。

translations.literal: The Herd Pasture Bureau said: "Horse superintendency pasture lands total more than forty-eight thousand qing; now taking fifty thousand horses as the standard, one horse occupies fifty mu — the four superintendencies of Daming and Guangping have little surplus farmland; they should temporarily remain as before.
translations.idiomatic: The Herd Pasture Bureau reported: "Horse superintendency pasture lands total more than forty-eight thousand qing. At fifty thousand horses, each requiring fifty mu, the four superintendencies of Daming and Guangping have little surplus farmland and should remain as before.

sentences.zh: 而原武、單鎮、洛陽、沙苑、淇水、安陽、東平等監，餘良田萬七千頃，可賦民以收芻粟。」

translations.literal: But the superintendencies of Yuanwu, Danzhen, Luoyang, Shayuan, Qishui, Anyang, and Dongping have seventeen thousand qing of surplus good farmland that can be assigned to the people to collect fodder and grain."
translations.idiomatic: But the superintendencies of Yuanwu, Danzhen, Luoyang, Shayuan, Qishui, Anyang, and Dongping have seventeen thousand qing of surplus good farmland that could be assigned to civilians to produce fodder and grain."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 已而樞密院又言：「舊制，以左、右騏驥院總司國馬。

translations.literal: Subsequently the Bureau of Military Affairs also said: "Under the old system, the Left and Right Fine Steed courtyards overall managed state horses.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the Bureau of Military Affairs reported: "Under the old system, the Left and Right Fine Steed courtyards overall managed state horses.

sentences.zh: 景德中，始增置群牧使副、都監、判官，以領廄牧之政。

translations.literal: During Jingde, deputy herd pasture commissioners, chief superintendents, and administrative judges were first added to lead stable-pasture policy.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jingde era, deputy herd pasture commissioners, chief superintendents, and administrative judges were added to oversee pasture administration.

sentences.zh: 使領雖重，未嘗躬自巡察，不能周知牧畜利病，以故馬不蕃息。

translations.literal: Although the commissioner-in-chief's position was weighty, he never personally inspected; he could not fully know the benefits and ills of pasture livestock — for this reason horses did not multiply.
translations.idiomatic: Although the commissioner-in-chief's position was prestigious, he never personally inspected operations and could not fully grasp the condition of the herds. For this reason horses failed to multiply.

sentences.zh: 今宜分置官局，專任責成。」

translations.literal: Now separate offices should be established with dedicated responsibility and accountability."
translations.idiomatic: Separate offices should now be established with dedicated responsibility and accountability."

sentences.zh: 乃詔河南、北分置監牧使，以劉航、崔台符為之，又置都監各一員。

translations.literal: Thereupon it was decreed that pasture commissioners be separately established south and north of the Yellow River, with Liu Hang and Cui Taifu appointed, and one chief superintendent each also established.
translations.idiomatic: Pasture commissioners were accordingly established separately north and south of the Yellow River, with Liu Hang and Cui Taifu appointed, each supported by one chief superintendent.

sentences.zh: 其在河陽者，為孳生監。

translations.literal: That at Heyang was a breeding superintendency.
translations.idiomatic: The superintendency at Heyang was designated for breeding.

sentences.zh: 凡外諸監並分屬兩使，各條上所當行者。

translations.literal: All outer superintendencies were divided between the two commissioners, each itemizing what should be carried out and reporting upward.
translations.idiomatic: All outer superintendencies were divided between the two commissioners, each reporting upward on matters within their jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 諸官吏若牧田縣令佐，並委監牧使舉劾，專隸樞密院，不領於群牧制置。

translations.literal: All officials such as pasture-land county magistrates and assistants were entrusted to pasture commissioners for impeachment; they were exclusively subordinate to the Bureau of Military Affairs, not overseen by the Herd Pasture Commissioner-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Officials including pasture-land county magistrates and assistants were placed under pasture commissioners for impeachment, reporting exclusively to the Bureau of Military Affairs rather than the Herd Pasture Commissioner-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 先是，群牧司請於河北、河東、陝西都總管治所各置一監，以便給軍，乃遣官下諸路詳度。

translations.literal: Previously, the Herd Pasture Bureau requested one superintendency be established at each general headquarters of Hebei, Hedong, and Shaanxi to facilitate army supply; officials were dispatched to the various circuits for detailed assessment.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, the Herd Pasture Bureau had requested a superintendency at each general headquarters in Hebei, Hedong, and Shaanxi to supply the armies, and officials were dispatched to assess the various circuits.

sentences.zh: 既又以知太原唐介之請，發沙苑馬五百，置監於交城。

translations.literal: Subsequently, at the request of Taiyuan Prefect Tang Jie, five hundred Shayuan horses were dispatched and a superintendency established at Jiaocheng.
translations.idiomatic: Subsequently, at Taiyuan Prefect Tang Jie's request, five hundred Shayuan horses were dispatched and a superintendency established at Jiaocheng.

sentences.zh: 又分置河南、河北兩使。

translations.literal: Pasture commissioners were also separately established south and north of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: Pasture commissioners were also separately appointed for the regions south and north of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 時上方留意牧監地，然諸監牧田皆寬衍，為人所冒占，故議者爭請收其餘資以佐芻粟。

translations.literal: At the time the emperor was attentive to superintendency pasture lands, yet all superintendency pasture fields were broad and expansive and encroached upon by people; therefore discussants competed to request collecting surplus revenue to supplement fodder and grain.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was then focused on superintendency pasture lands, but these broad fields had been widely encroached upon, and critics competed to propose collecting surplus revenue to supplement fodder and grain supplies.

sentences.zh: 言利者乘之，始以增賦入為務。

translations.literal: Profit-seekers seized the opportunity and began to make increasing tax revenue their task.
translations.idiomatic: Profit-seekers seized the opportunity and made increasing tax revenue their priority.

sentences.zh: 二年，詔括河南北監牧司總牧地。

translations.literal: In the second year, it was decreed to survey the total pasture lands of the pasture bureaus south and north of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, a survey was ordered of total pasture lands under the pasture bureaus north and south of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 舊籍六萬八千頃，而今籍五萬五千，餘數皆隱於民。

translations.literal: The old register showed sixty-eight thousand qing; the current register fifty-five thousand — the remainder all concealed by the people.
translations.idiomatic: The old register recorded sixty-eight thousand qing, but the current register showed only fifty-five thousand, with the remainder concealed by civilians.

sentences.zh: 自是，請以牧地賦民者紛然，而諸監尋廢。

translations.literal: From this, requests to assign pasture lands to the people proliferated, and the various superintendencies were soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: From this point, proposals to assign pasture lands to civilians proliferated, and the various superintendencies were soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 是歲，天下應在馬凡十五萬三千六百有奇。

translations.literal: That year, horses due for service nationwide totaled one hundred fifty-three thousand six hundred odd.
translations.idiomatic: That year, horses on the national rolls totaled more than one hundred fifty-three thousand six hundred.

sentences.zh: 初，內外班直、諸軍馬以四月下槽出牧，迄八月上槽，風雨勞逸之不齊，故多病斃。

translations.literal: Initially, inner and outer guard direct units and various army horses left the mangers for pasture in the fourth month and returned to the mangers by the eighth month; wind, rain, and uneven labor and rest caused many to sicken and die.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, guard direct units and various army horses were turned out to pasture in the fourth month and returned to the mangers by the eighth month. Uneven exposure to wind, rain, labor, and rest caused many to sicken and die.

sentences.zh: 圉人歲被榜罰，吏緣牧事害民，棚井科率無寧歲。

translations.literal: Grooms were beaten and fined annually; officials used pasture affairs to harm the people; stable and well levies brought no year of peace.
translations.idiomatic: Grooms were beaten and fined each year; officials exploited pasture affairs to harm civilians; and levies for stables and wells brought no year of peace.

sentences.zh: 四年十月，乃命同修起居注曾孝寬較度其利害。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year, Co-compiler of the Daily Record Zeng Xiokuan was ordered to assess advantages and disadvantages.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fourth year, Co-compiler of the Daily Record Zeng Xiokuan was ordered to assess the advantages and disadvantages.

sentences.zh: 孝寬請罷諸班直、諸軍馬出牧，以田募民出租。

translations.literal: Xiokuan requested abolishing pasture turnout for guard direct units and various army horses, recruiting civilians to rent the land.
translations.idiomatic: Xiokuan proposed ending pasture turnout for guard direct units and army horses and recruiting civilians to rent the pasture lands.

sentences.zh: 詔自來年如所請，仍令三司備當牧五月芻粟。

translations.literal: It was decreed that from the following year his request be followed; the State Finance Commission was still ordered to prepare the fifth month's fodder and grain for pasture.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved from the following year, with the State Finance Commission ordered to supply the fifth month's fodder and grain for stalled horses.

sentences.zh: 五年，廢太原監。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the Taiyuan Superintendency was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, the Taiyuan Superintendency was abolished.

sentences.zh: 七年，廢東平、原武監，而合淇水兩監為一。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, the Dongping and Yuanwu superintendencies were abolished, and the two Qishui superintendencies were merged into one.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, the Dongping and Yuanwu superintendencies were abolished and the two Qishui superintendencies merged into one.

sentences.zh: 八年，遂廢河南北八監，惟存沙苑一監，而兩監司牧亦罷矣。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the eight superintendencies south and north of the Yellow River were abolished; only the one Shayuan Superintendency remained, and the two pasture bureaus were also abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, all eight superintendencies north and south of the Yellow River were abolished, leaving only Shayuan. The two pasture bureaus were abolished as well.

sentences.zh: 沙苑先以隸陝西提舉監牧，至是，復屬之群牧司。

translations.literal: Shayuan had first been subordinate to the Shaanxi Pasture Superintendency; at this time it was again assigned to the Herd Pasture Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Shayuan had first been subordinate to the Shaanxi Pasture Superintendency but was now reassigned to the Herd Pasture Bureau.

sentences.zh: 始議廢監時，群牧制置使文彥博言：「議者欲賦牧地與民而收租課，散國馬於編戶而責孳息，非便。」

translations.literal: When abolition of superintendencies was first discussed, Herd Pasture Commissioner-in-Chief Wen Yanbo said: "Discussants wish to assign pasture lands to the people and collect rent levies, dispersing state horses among registered households and demanding breeding — this is not advantageous."
translations.idiomatic: When abolition of superintendencies was first discussed, Herd Pasture Commissioner-in-Chief Wen Yanbo argued: "Critics wish to assign pasture lands to civilians and collect rent, dispersing state horses among registered households and demanding breeding returns. This is impractical."

sentences.zh: 詔元絳、蔡確較其利害上之。

translations.literal: It was decreed that Yuan Jiang and Cai Que assess advantages and disadvantages and report upward.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Jiang and Cai Que were ordered to assess the advantages and disadvantages and report.

sentences.zh: 於是中書、樞密院言：「河南北十二監，起熙寧二年至五年，歲出馬一千六百四十匹，可給騎兵者二百六十四，餘僅足配郵傳。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs said: "The twelve superintendencies south and north of the Yellow River, from the second to fifth year of Xining, annually produced one thousand six hundred forty horses; two hundred sixty-four could supply cavalry; the rest barely sufficed for postal relay.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs then reported: "The twelve superintendencies north and south of the Yellow River, from the second to fifth year of Xining, produced sixteen hundred forty horses annually — only two hundred sixty-four suitable for cavalry, with the rest barely sufficient for postal relay.

sentences.zh: 而兩監牧吏卒雜費及所占地租，為緡錢五十三萬九千有奇，計所出馬為錢三萬六千四百餘緡而已。

translations.literal: Yet the two pasture bureaus' officials, soldiers, and miscellaneous expenses plus occupied land rent totaled five hundred thirty-nine thousand odd strings of cash; calculating the horses produced, the cost was only three hundred sixty-four thousand odd strings.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the two pasture bureaus' personnel costs and land rents totaled more than five hundred thirty-nine thousand strings of cash, making each horse produced cost more than three hundred sixty-four thousand strings.

sentences.zh: 今九監見馬三萬，若不更制，則日就損耗。」

translations.literal: Now the nine superintendencies have thirty thousand horses on hand; if the system is not reformed, they will daily decline."
translations.idiomatic: The nine remaining superintendencies held thirty thousand horses; without reform, they would continue to decline."

sentences.zh: 於是卒廢之，以其善馬分隸諸監，餘馬皆斥賣，收其地租，給市易茶本錢，分寄籍常平、出子錢，以為市馬之直。

translations.literal: Thereupon they were finally abolished; fine horses were divided among the various superintendencies; remaining horses were all sold off; land rent was collected and given as capital for the Market Exchange tea fund, deposited in the Ever-Normal Granary and interest-bearing loan accounts as horse purchase prices.
translations.idiomatic: The superintendencies were finally abolished. Fine horses were distributed among remaining superintendencies; the rest were sold. Land rents funded the Market Exchange tea capital and were deposited in Ever-Normal Granary and interest-bearing loan accounts for horse purchases.

sentences.zh: 監兵五千，以為廣固指揮，修治京城焉。

translations.literal: Five thousand superintendency soldiers became the Guanggu Command to repair and maintain the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Five thousand superintendency soldiers were reorganized as the Guanggu Command to repair and maintain the capital.

sentences.zh: 後遂廢高陽、真定、太原、大名、定州五監。

translations.literal: Later the five superintendencies of Gaoyang, Zhending, Taiyuan, Daming, and Dingzhou were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Gaoyang, Zhending, Taiyuan, Daming, and Dingzhou superintendencies were abolished.

sentences.zh: 凡廢監錢歸市易之外，又以給熙河歲計。

translations.literal: Besides abolished superintendency funds going to the Market Exchange, they also supplied the Xixi annual budget.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond funding the Market Exchange, abolished superintendency revenues also supplied the Xixi annual budget.

sentences.zh: 諸監既廢，淤田司請廣行淤溉，增課以募耕者，而河北制置牧田所繼言，牧田沒於民者五千七百餘頃。

translations.literal: Once the superintendencies were abolished, the Silt-Farmland Bureau requested broad silt irrigation, increasing levies to recruit farmers; the Hebei Pasture-Land Commission followed with a report that five thousand seven hundred odd qing of pasture land had sunk into civilian hands.
translations.idiomatic: After the superintendencies were abolished, the Silt-Farmland Bureau proposed broad silt irrigation with increased levies to recruit farmers. The Hebei Pasture-Land Commission reported that more than five thousand seven hundred qing of pasture land had been lost to civilian occupation.

sentences.zh: 乃嚴侵冒之法，而加告獲之賞，自是利入增多。

translations.literal: Strict encroachment laws were enacted with increased rewards for reporting violations; from this revenue increased.
translations.idiomatic: Strict encroachment laws were enacted with increased rewards for reporting violations, and revenue subsequently increased.

sentences.zh: 元豐三年，廢監租錢遂至百一十六萬，自群牧使而下，賜賚有差。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanfeng, abolished superintendency rent revenue reached one million one hundred sixty thousand; from the herd pasture commissioner downward, rewards were given in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yuanfeng (1080), abolished superintendency rent revenue reached one million one hundred sixty thousand cash. Rewards were distributed in varying amounts from the herd pasture commissioner downward.

sentences.zh: 乃命太常博士路昌衡、秘書丞王得臣與逐路轉運司、開封府界提點司按租地，約三年中價以定歲額。

translations.literal: Court of Imperial Sacrifices Doctor Lu Changheng and Secretariat Assistant Director Wang Dechen were ordered, together with each circuit's transport commission and the Kaifeng capital-district inspectorate, to survey rental lands and set annual quotas based on three-year average prices.
translations.idiomatic: Court of Imperial Sacrifices Doctor Lu Changheng and Secretariat Assistant Director Wang Dechen were ordered, together with each circuit's transport commission and the Kaifeng capital-district inspectorate, to survey rental lands and set annual quotas based on three-year average prices.

sentences.zh: 若催督違滯，以擅支封樁法論。

translations.literal: If collection was delayed through negligence, prosecution followed the law on unauthorized disbursement of sealed reserves.
translations.idiomatic: Delays in collection would be prosecuted under the law on unauthorized disbursement of sealed reserves.

sentences.zh: 初，經制熙河邊防財用司奏於岷州𢇲川、荔川、閭川砦、通遠軍熟羊砦置牧養十監，議者繼言蕃馬法，帝欲試之近甸。

translations.literal: Initially, the Xixi Frontier Finance Commission memorialized establishing ten pasture-nurture superintendencies at Minzhou's Dichuan, Lichuan, and Luanchuan stockades and Tongyuan Army's Shuyang Stockade; discussants subsequently spoke of the Tangut horse method; the emperor wished to test it in the near capital districts.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, the Xixi Frontier Finance Commission proposed ten pasture-nurture superintendencies at Dichuan, Lichuan, and Luanchuan stockades in Minzhou and Shuyang Stockade in Tongyuan Army. Critics then discussed the Tangut horse method, and the emperor wished to test it in the near capital districts.

sentences.zh: 六年，手詔樞密院：「牧馬重事，經始之際，宜得左右近臣以總其政。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, a handwritten edict to the Bureau of Military Affairs: "Horse pasture is a weighty matter; at its inception, close ministers should be obtained to overall manage its policy.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, the emperor wrote to the Bureau of Military Affairs: "Horse pasture is a weighty matter. At its inception, close ministers should oversee its administration.

sentences.zh: 今自霧澤陂牧馬所造法，始於畿內置十監，以次推之諸路。

translations.literal: Now following the method created at the Wuze Po horse pasture, begin by establishing ten superintendencies within the capital districts, then extend in order to the various circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Following the method developed at the Wuze Po horse pasture, ten superintendencies should first be established within the capital districts, then extended to the various circuits.

sentences.zh: 宜令樞密院都承旨張誠一、副都承旨張山甫經度制置，權不隸尚書駕部及太僕寺。

translations.literal: Bureau of Military Affairs Chief Receptionist Zhang Chengyi and Vice Chief Receptionist Zhang Shanfu should be ordered to plan and establish it, temporarily not subordinate to the Ministry's Carriage Section or the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau of Military Affairs Chief Receptionist Zhang Chengyi and Vice Chief Receptionist Zhang Shanfu should plan and establish the system, temporarily independent of the Ministry's Carriage Section and the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 有當自朝廷處分者，樞密院主之。」

translations.literal: Matters requiring court disposition shall be managed by the Bureau of Military Affairs."
translations.idiomatic: Matters requiring imperial disposition would be managed by the Bureau of Military Affairs."

sentences.zh: 已而其說皆不效。

translations.literal: Subsequently none of these proposals proved effective.
translations.idiomatic: None of these proposals proved effective.

sentences.zh: 八年，同提舉經度制置曹誦言：「自崇儀副使溫從吉建議創孳生監，迨今二年，駒不蕃而死者益眾。」

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Co-Commissioner for Planning and Establishment Cao Song said: "Since Vice Envoy for Honored Rites Wen Congji proposed establishing breeding superintendencies, until now two years — foals have not multiplied and deaths have increased."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Co-Commissioner for Planning and Establishment Cao Song reported: "Since Vice Envoy for Honored Rites Wen Congji proposed breeding superintendencies two years ago, foals have failed to multiply while deaths have increased."

sentences.zh: 乃命御史臺校核，自置監以來，得駒不及一分四厘，馬死已十分之六。

translations.literal: The Censorate was ordered to verify: since establishing the superintendencies, foals obtained did not reach one percent four tenths; horse deaths already reached six tenths.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate verified that since the superintendencies were established, foals born fell short of one point four percent while horse deaths reached sixty percent.

sentences.zh: 於是責議者及提舉官，而罷畿內十監。

translations.literal: Thereupon the proposers and supervising officials were held accountable, and the ten capital-district superintendencies were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The proposers and supervising officials were held accountable, and the ten capital-district superintendencies were abolished.

sentences.zh: 元祐初，議興廢監，以復舊制。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanyou, abolished superintendencies were discussed for revival to restore the old system.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Yuanyou era, abolished superintendencies were discussed for revival to restore the old system.

sentences.zh: 於是詔庫部郎中郭茂恂往陝西、河東所當置監，尋又下河北陝西轉運、提點刑獄司按行河、渭、並、晉之間牧田以聞。

translations.literal: Thereupon Treasury Section Director Guo Maoxun was ordered to Shaanxi and Hedong to determine where superintendencies should be established; soon the Hebei and Shaanxi transport commissions and judicial inspectorates were also ordered to inspect pasture lands between the Yellow, Wei, Bing, and Jin rivers and report.
translations.idiomatic: Treasury Section Director Guo Maoxun was dispatched to Shaanxi and Hedong to determine where superintendencies should be established. Soon the Hebei and Shaanxi transport and judicial inspectorates were ordered to inspect pasture lands between the Yellow, Wei, Bing, and Jin rivers and report.

sentences.zh: 時已罷保甲，教騎兵，而還戶馬於民。

translations.literal: At the time the baojia system had been abolished, cavalry was being trained, and household horses were being returned to the people.
translations.idiomatic: The baojia system had been abolished, cavalry training was underway, and household horses were being returned to civilians.

sentences.zh: 於是右司諫王巖叟言：「兵之所恃在馬，而能蕃息之者，牧監也。

translations.literal: Thereupon Right Office Remonstrance Official Wang Yansou said: "What the army relies upon is horses, and what can make them multiply is the pasture superintendencies.
translations.idiomatic: Right Office Remonstrance Official Wang Yansou argued: "Armies depend on horses, and pasture superintendencies are what make them multiply.

sentences.zh: 昔廢監之初，識者皆知十年之後天下當乏馬。

translations.literal: When superintendencies were abolished in the past, the knowledgeable all knew that within ten years the empire would lack horses.
translations.idiomatic: When superintendencies were abolished, the knowledgeable all predicted a nationwide horse shortage within ten years.

sentences.zh: 已而不待十年，其弊已見，此甚非國之利也。

translations.literal: Already, without waiting ten years, the harm has appeared — this is greatly not to the state's benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Already, without waiting ten years, the harm was evident. This greatly harmed the state.

sentences.zh: 乞收還戶馬三萬，復置監如故，監牧事委之轉運官，而不專置使。

translations.literal: I request recovering thirty thousand household horses, restoring superintendencies as before, entrusting pasture affairs to transport officials without specially appointing commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: I request recovering thirty thousand household horses, restoring superintendencies as before, and entrusting pasture affairs to transport officials without appointing special commissioners.

sentences.zh: 今鄆州之東平，北京之大名、元城，衛州之淇水，相州之安陽，洺州之廣平監，以及瀛、定之間棚塞草地疆畫具存，使臣牧卒大半猶在，稍加招集，則指顧之間措置可定，而人免納錢之害，國收牧馬之利，豈非計之得哉？

translations.literal: Now Dongping of Yanzhou, Daming and Yuancheng of the Northern Capital, Qishui of Weizhou, Anyang of Xiangzhou, the Guangping Superintendency of Luozhou, and the stable and pasture lands between Ying and Ding — boundaries all remain; commissioner officials and pasture soldiers mostly still exist. With slight recruitment, arrangements can be settled in a glance. The people escape the harm of paying cash; the state receives pasture horse benefits — is this not a good plan?
translations.idiomatic: Dongping in Yanzhou, Daming and Yuancheng in the Northern Capital, Qishui in Weizhou, Anyang in Xiangzhou, the Guangping Superintendency in Luozhou, and pasture lands between Ying and Ding all retain their boundaries. Most commissioner officials and pasture soldiers remain. With modest recruitment, arrangements could be settled quickly. Civilians would escape cash payments; the state would regain pasture benefits. Is this not sound policy?

sentences.zh: 又況廢監以來，牧地之賦民者，為害多端，若復置監牧而收地入官，則百姓戴恩，如釋重負矣。」

translations.literal: Moreover, since abolishing superintendencies, assigning pasture lands to the people has caused many harms; if superintendencies are restored and lands recovered to the government, the people would receive grace as if released from a heavy burden."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, since abolishing superintendencies, assigning pasture lands to civilians has caused many harms. Restoring superintendencies and reclaiming the land would be a great relief to the people."

sentences.zh: 自是，洛陽、單鎮、原武、淇水、東平、安陽等監皆復。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Luoyang, Danzhen, Yuanwu, Qishui, Dongping, Anyang, and other superintendencies were all restored.
translations.idiomatic: The Luoyang, Danzhen, Yuanwu, Qishui, Dongping, Anyang, and other superintendencies were all restored.

sentences.zh: 初，熙寧中，並天駟四監為二，而左、右天廄坊亦罷。

translations.literal: Initially, during Xining, the four Heavenly Horse superintendencies were merged into two, and the Left and Right Heavenly Stable Wards were also abolished.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xining era, the four Heavenly Horse superintendencies had been merged into two, and the Left and Right Heavenly Stable Wards abolished.

sentences.zh: 至是，復左、右天廄坊。

translations.literal: At this time, the Left and Right Heavenly Stable Wards were restored.
translations.idiomatic: At this point, the Left and Right Heavenly Stable Wards were restored.

sentences.zh: 時又有旨，內外馬事並隸太僕寺，不由駕部而達尚書省。

translations.literal: At the time there was also an order that inner and outer horse affairs all be subordinate to the Court of the Imperial Stud, not passing through the Carriage Section to reach the Ministry.
translations.idiomatic: An order also placed all inner and outer horse affairs under the Court of the Imperial Stud, bypassing the Carriage Section to reach the Ministry directly.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書王存、右司諫王覿言：「先帝講求歷代之法，正省、台、寺、監之職，上下相繼，各有統制。

translations.literal: Minister of War Wang Cun and Right Office Remonstrance Official Wang Di said: "The late emperor studied methods of successive dynasties, rectifying the duties of ministries, censorates, courts, and commissions — superior and subordinate in succession, each with oversight.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Wang Cun and Right Office Remonstrance Official Wang Di argued: "The late emperor studied methods of successive dynasties and rectified the duties of ministries, censorates, courts, and commissions, each with proper hierarchical oversight.

sentences.zh: 其間或濡滯不通，宜量加裁正，不可因而隳紊。」

translations.literal: Where obstruction or stagnation occurred, appropriate correction should be applied — one must not thereby destroy order."
translations.idiomatic: Where obstruction occurred, appropriate correction should be applied. Order must not be destroyed in the process."

sentences.zh: 言不果行。

translations.literal: The proposal was not implemented.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was not implemented.

sentences.zh: 又詔舊屬群牧司者專隸太僕寺，直達樞密院，不由尚書省及駕部。

translations.literal: It was also decreed that what formerly belonged to the Herd Pasture Bureau was exclusively subordinate to the Court of the Imperial Stud, reporting directly to the Bureau of Military Affairs, not passing through the Ministry or Carriage Section.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also placed former Herd Pasture Bureau affairs exclusively under the Court of the Imperial Stud, reporting directly to the Bureau of Military Affairs and bypassing the Ministry and Carriage Section.

sentences.zh: 至崇寧中，始詔如元豐舊制。

translations.literal: By the Chongning era, it was first decreed to follow the Yuanfeng old system.
translations.idiomatic: By the Chongning era, the Yuanfeng system was restored.

sentences.zh: 紹聖初，用事者更以其意為廢置，而時議復變。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shaosheng, those in power again abolished and established according to their own wishes, and contemporary opinion changed again.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Shaosheng era, those in power again reorganized according to their own preferences, and public opinion shifted once more.

sentences.zh: 太僕寺言，府界牧田，占佃之外，尚存三千餘頃，議復畿內孳生十監。

translations.literal: The Court of the Imperial Stud said that capital-district pasture lands, beyond occupied tenancy, still had more than three thousand qing remaining; revival of ten capital-district breeding superintendencies was discussed.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of the Imperial Stud reported that beyond occupied tenancy, more than three thousand qing of capital-district pasture land remained, and revival of ten capital-district breeding superintendencies was discussed.

sentences.zh: 詔以莊宅副使麥文丙、內殿崇班王景儉充提舉。

translations.literal: It was decreed that Vice Commissioner for Estates Mai Wenbing and Inner Hall Honored Company Wang Jingjian serve as commissioners-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commissioner for Estates Mai Wenbing and Inner Hall Honored Company Wang Jingjian were appointed commissioners-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 後二年而給地牧馬之政行矣。

translations.literal: Two years later the land-grant pasture horse policy was implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later, the land-grant pasture horse policy was implemented.

sentences.zh: 先是，知任縣韓筠等建議，凡授民牧田一頃，為官牧一馬而蠲其租。

translations.literal: Previously, Ren County Prefect Han Jun and others proposed: for each qing of pasture land granted to the people, one horse would be pastured for the government and rent exempted.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, Ren County Prefect Han Jun and others proposed that for each qing of pasture land granted to civilians, one horse would be pastured for the government in exchange for rent exemption.

sentences.zh: 縣籍其高下、老壯、毛色，歲一閱，亡失者責償，已佃牧田者依上養馬。

translations.literal: The county registered quality, age, strength, and coat color; inspected once per year; those lost were held liable for compensation; those already tenanting pasture land followed the above horse-rearing rules.
translations.idiomatic: The county would register each horse's quality, age, strength, and coat color, inspect annually, hold owners liable for losses, and apply the same rules to those already tenanting pasture land.

sentences.zh: 知邢州張赴上其說，且謂授田一頃為官牧一馬，較陝西沿邊弓箭手既養馬又戍邊者為優，試之一監一縣，當有利而無害。

translations.literal: Xingzhou Prefect Zhang Fu submitted the proposal and said granting one qing for one government horse was superior to Shaanxi frontier archer-soldiers who both raised horses and guarded the border; testing in one superintendency and one county should bring benefit without harm.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzhou Prefect Zhang Fu submitted the proposal, arguing that one qing for one government horse was preferable to the Shaanxi frontier archer-soldiers who both raised horses and guarded the border. A trial in one superintendency and one county should bring benefit without harm.

sentences.zh: 樞密院是其請，且言：「熙寧中，罷諸監以賦民，歲收緡錢至百餘萬。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Military Affairs approved the request and said: "During Xining, superintendencies were abolished and lands assigned to the people; annual revenue reached more than one million strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Military Affairs approved the request and noted: "During Xining, abolishing superintendencies and assigning lands to civilians yielded more than one million strings of cash annually.

sentences.zh: 元祐初，未嘗講明利害，惟務罷元豐、熙寧之政，奪已佃之田而復舊監。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanyou, advantages and disadvantages were not clarified; they only sought to abolish Yuanfeng and Xining policies, seizing already tenanted fields and restoring old superintendencies.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yuanyou, without weighing advantages and disadvantages, the sole aim was abolishing Yuanfeng and Xining policies, seizing tenanted fields, and restoring old superintendencies.

sentences.zh: 桑棗井廬多所毀伐，監牧官吏為費不貲，牧卒擾民，棚井抑配，為害非一。

translations.literal: Mulberry, jujube, wells, and dwellings were widely destroyed; superintendency officials' expenses were incalculable; pasture soldiers harassed the people; stable and well forced allocations — harms were not one.
translations.idiomatic: Mulberry and jujube trees, wells, and dwellings were widely destroyed. Superintendency expenses were incalculable, pasture soldiers harassed civilians, and forced allocations for stables and wells caused many harms.

sentences.zh: 蓋自復監以來，臣僚屢陳公私之害。

translations.literal: Since restoring superintendencies, officials repeatedly memorialized public and private harms.
translations.idiomatic: Since restoring superintendencies, officials had repeatedly memorialized about public and private harms.

sentences.zh: 若循元祐倉卒更張之法，久當益弊。

translations.literal: If following Yuanyou's hasty reform methods, over time harm would increase.
translations.idiomatic: Following Yuanyou's hasty reforms would only worsen matters over time.

sentences.zh: 且左右廂今歲籍馬萬三千有奇，堪配軍者無幾，惟沙苑六千疋愈於他監。

translations.literal: Moreover, the left and right wings this year registered more than thirteen thousand horses; few were suitable for army assignment — only Shayuan's six thousand were better than other superintendencies.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the left and right wings registered more than thirteen thousand horses this year, but few were suitable for army assignment. Only Shayuan's six thousand surpassed other superintendencies.

sentences.zh: 今赴等所陳授田養馬，既蠲其租不責以孳息，而不願者無所抑勒，又限以尺寸，則緩急皆可用之馬矣。」

translations.literal: Now Zhang Fu and others propose land-grant horse rearing — rent is exempted and breeding is not demanded; the unwilling are not coerced; height limits are set — thus horses usable in both urgent and routine situations."
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Fu's land-grant horse rearing exempts rent without demanding breeding returns, imposes no coercion on the unwilling, and sets height requirements — yielding horses usable in both urgent and routine situations."

sentences.zh: 乃具為條畫，下太僕寺，應監牧州縣悉行之。

translations.literal: Detailed regulations were drawn up and sent to the Court of the Imperial Stud; all superintendency prefectures and counties were to implement them.
translations.idiomatic: Detailed regulations were drawn up and sent to the Court of the Imperial Stud for implementation in all superintendency prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 時殿中侍御史陳次升言：「給地牧馬，其初始於邢州守令之請，未嘗下監司詳度。

translations.literal: At the time Palace Attendant Censor Chen Cisheng said: "Land-grant pasture horses — this initially began with a request from Xingzhou prefectural officials; it was never sent to supervisory commissions for detailed assessment.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Censor Chen Cisheng argued: "Land-grant pasture horses began with a request from Xingzhou prefectural officials and was never assessed by supervisory commissions.

sentences.zh: 諸路各有利害，既不可知。

translations.literal: Each circuit has its own advantages and disadvantages — this cannot be known.
translations.idiomatic: Each circuit has its own advantages and disadvantages, which remain unknown.

sentences.zh: 民居與田相遠者，難就耕牧。

translations.literal: Where civilian dwellings are far from the land, farming and pasture are difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Where civilian dwellings are far from the land, farming and grazing are impractical.

sentences.zh: 一頃之地所直不多，而亡失責償，為錢四五十千，必非人情所願。」

translations.literal: One qing of land is not worth much, yet loss liability for compensation is forty to fifty thousand cash — surely not what people wish."
translations.idiomatic: One qing of land is not worth much, yet loss liability runs forty to fifty thousand cash — surely not what people would willingly accept."

sentences.zh: 言竟不行。

translations.literal: The proposal was ultimately not implemented.
translations.idiomatic: The objection was ultimately ignored.

sentences.zh: 時同知樞密院者，曾布也。

translations.literal: At the time the Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs was Zeng Bu.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs at the time was Zeng Bu.

sentences.zh: 四年，遂廢淇水、單鎮、安陽、洛陽、原武監，罷提點所及左右廂，惟存東平、沙苑二監。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the Qishui, Danzhen, Anyang, Luoyang, and Yuanwu superintendencies were abolished; the inspectorate and left and right wings were abolished; only the Dongping and Shayuan superintendencies remained.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, the Qishui, Danzhen, Anyang, Luoyang, and Yuanwu superintendencies were abolished along with the inspectorate and left and right wings, leaving only Dongping and Shayuan.

sentences.zh: 曾布自敘其事曰：「元祐中，復置監牧，兩廂所養馬止萬三千匹，而不堪者過半。

translations.literal: Zeng Bu narrated the matter himself: "During Yuanyou, superintendencies were restored; the two wings raised only thirteen thousand horses, and more than half were unsuitable.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Bu himself recounted: "During Yuanyou, superintendencies were restored, but the two wings raised only thirteen thousand horses, more than half unsuitable.

sentences.zh: 今既以租錢置蕃落十指揮於陝西，養馬三千五百。

translations.literal: Now rent revenue has established the Tribal Ten Fingers Command in Shaanxi, raising three thousand five hundred horses.
translations.idiomatic: Now rent revenue funds the Tribal Ten Fingers Command in Shaanxi, raising thirty-five hundred horses.

sentences.zh: 又人戶願養者亦數千，而所存兩監各可牧萬馬。

translations.literal: Households willing to raise horses also number several thousand, and the two remaining superintendencies can each pasture ten thousand horses.
translations.idiomatic: Several thousand households also volunteer to raise horses, and the two remaining superintendencies can each pasture ten thousand horses.

sentences.zh: 馬數多於舊監，而所省官吏之費非一，近世良法，未之能及。」

translations.literal: Horse numbers exceed the old superintendencies, while official expenses saved are considerable — a fine method of recent times, unmatched."
translations.idiomatic: Horse numbers exceed the old superintendencies while official expenses are greatly reduced — an unmatched method of recent times."

sentences.zh: 時三省皆稱善。

translations.literal: At the time all three secretariats praised it.
translations.idiomatic: All three secretariats praised the arrangement.

sentences.zh: 其後，沙苑復隸陝西買馬監牧司，而東平監仍廢。

translations.literal: Subsequently, Shayuan was again subordinate to the Shaanxi Horse Purchase and Pasture Superintendency, while the Dongping Superintendency remained abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Subsequently, Shayuan was reassigned to the Shaanxi Horse Purchase and Pasture Superintendency, while Dongping remained abolished.

sentences.zh: 崇寧元年，有司較諸路田養馬之數，凡一千八百疋有奇，而河北西路占一千四百，他路自二百匹以下，至河東路僅九匹，而開封府界、京西南路、京東東路皆無應募者。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongning, relevant offices compared land-reared horse numbers across circuits — one thousand eight hundred odd in all; Hebei West Circuit accounted for one thousand four hundred; other circuits ranged from two hundred down; Hedong Circuit had only nine; Kaifeng capital district, southwestern Jing, and eastern Jing east had no volunteers.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongning (1102), officials compared land-reared horse numbers across circuits — more than eighteen hundred total. Hebei West Circuit accounted for fourteen hundred; other circuits ranged downward to just nine in Hedong. Kaifeng capital district, southwestern Jing, and eastern Jing east had no volunteers.

sentences.zh: 蓋法雖已具，而猶未及行也。

translations.literal: Although the law was already complete, it had not yet been fully implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Although the regulations were complete, they had not yet been fully implemented.

sentences.zh: 大觀元年，尚書省言：「元祐置監，馬不蕃息，而費用不貲。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daguan, the Ministry said: "Yuanyou-established superintendencies — horses did not multiply, and expenses were incalculable.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daguan (1107), the Ministry reported: "Yuanyou-established superintendencies failed to multiply horses while expenses were incalculable.

sentences.zh: 今沙苑最號多馬，然占牧田九千餘頃，芻粟、官曹歲費緡錢四十餘萬，而牧馬止及六千。

translations.literal: Now Shayuan is most renowned for many horses, yet it occupies more than nine thousand qing of pasture land; fodder, grain, and official offices annually cost more than four hundred thousand strings of cash, while pastured horses reach only six thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Shayuan is renowned for its herds, yet it occupies more than nine thousand qing of pasture land. Fodder, grain, and official offices cost more than four hundred thousand strings annually while only six thousand horses are pastured.

sentences.zh: 自元符元年至二年，亡失者三千九百。

translations.literal: From the first to second year of Yuanfu, three thousand nine hundred were lost.
translations.idiomatic: From the first to second year of Yuanfu, thirty-nine hundred horses were lost.

sentences.zh: 且素不調習，不中於用。

translations.literal: Moreover, they are never trained and are unsuitable for use.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, they were never trained and unsuitable for use.

sentences.zh: 以九千頃之田、四十萬緡之費，養馬而不適於用，又亡失如此，利害灼然可見。

translations.literal: Using nine thousand qing of land and four hundred thousand strings of cash to raise horses unsuitable for use, with such losses — advantages and disadvantages are clearly visible.
translations.idiomatic: Using nine thousand qing and four hundred thousand strings to raise unusable horses with such losses — the balance of costs and benefits is clearly unfavorable.

sentences.zh: 今以九千頃之田，計其磽瘠，三分去一，猶得良田六千頃。

translations.literal: Now with nine thousand qing of land, calculating barren and poor quality, removing one third, good farmland of six thousand qing still remains.
translations.idiomatic: Of the nine thousand qing, even after removing one third as barren, six thousand qing of good farmland would remain.

sentences.zh: 以直計之，頃為錢五百餘緡，以一頃募一馬，則人得地利，馬得所養，可以紹述先帝隱兵於農之意。

translations.literal: Calculating by price, each qing is worth more than five hundred strings of cash; recruiting one horse per qing — people gain land benefit, horses gain proper care — this can continue the late emperor's intent of hiding soldiers among farmers.
translations.idiomatic: At more than five hundred strings per qing, recruiting one horse per qing would benefit both people and horses, continuing the late emperor's intent of embedding military capacity within agriculture.

sentences.zh: 請下永興軍路提點刑獄司及同州詳度以聞。

translations.literal: I request the Yongxing Army circuit judicial inspectorate and Tongzhou be ordered to assess in detail and report.
translations.idiomatic: I request that the Yongxing Army circuit judicial inspectorate and Tongzhou assess the proposal in detail and report.

sentences.zh: 俟見實利，則六路新邊閑田，當以次推行。

translations.literal: Once actual benefit is seen, the six circuits' new frontier idle lands should be extended in order.
translations.idiomatic: Once actual benefits were demonstrated, the policy would be extended in order to idle lands along the six new frontier circuits.

sentences.zh: 時熙河蘭湟路牧馬司又請兼募願養牝馬者，每收三駒，以其二歸官，一充賞，詔行之。

translations.literal: At the time the Xixi Lantang circuit Horse Pasture Bureau also requested additionally recruiting those willing to raise brood mares; for every three foals collected, two returned to the government and one served as reward — the decree ordered implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The Xixi Lantang circuit Horse Pasture Bureau also requested recruiting volunteers to raise brood mares: of every three foals, two would go to the government and one to the breeder as reward. The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 是歲，臣僚言岷州應募養馬者至萬餘匹，於是自守貳而下，遞賞有差。

translations.literal: That year, officials said Minzhou volunteers raising horses reached more than ten thousand; thereupon from prefects and vice-prefects downward, graded rewards were given in succession.
translations.idiomatic: That year, officials reported that Minzhou volunteers had raised more than ten thousand horses, and graded rewards were distributed from prefects and vice-prefects downward.

sentences.zh: 明年，詔熙河路應縣、鎮、城、砦、關、堡官並兼管幹給地牧事。

translations.literal: The next year, it was decreed that all Minzhou county, town, fortress, stockade, pass, and fort officials also concurrently manage land-grant pasture affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, all county, town, fortress, stockade, pass, and fort officials in the Xixi circuit were ordered to concurrently manage land-grant pasture affairs.

sentences.zh: 四年，復罷京東西路給地牧馬，復東平監。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, land-grant pasture horses in eastern and western Jing were abolished again, and the Dongping Superintendency was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, land-grant pasture horses in eastern and western Jing were abolished again and the Dongping Superintendency restored.

sentences.zh: 政和二年，詔諸路復行給地牧馬，復罷東平監。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenghe, it was decreed that all circuits again implement land-grant pasture horses, and the Dongping Superintendency was again abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenghe (1112), all circuits were ordered to resume land-grant pasture horses, and the Dongping Superintendency was abolished again.

sentences.zh: 五年，提舉河東給地牧馬尚中行以奏報稽違，且欲擅更法，詔授遠小監當官。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Hedong Land-Grant Pasture Horse Commissioner Shang Zhongxing was slow in memorializing and wished to change the law on his own authority; he was decreed appointed to a distant minor superintendency post.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Hedong Land-Grant Pasture Horse Commissioner Shang Zhongxing was demoted to a distant minor superintendency post for delayed reporting and attempting to alter the law on his own authority.

sentences.zh: 於是人皆趣令，牧守、提舉以率先就緒遷官第賞者甚眾。

translations.literal: Thereupon people all hastened to comply; many pasture prefects and commissioners received rank advancement and graded rewards for being first to complete preparations.
translations.idiomatic: Officials then rushed to comply, and many pasture prefects and commissioners received promotions and graded rewards for completing preparations first.

sentences.zh: 七年，有司言給地增牧，法成令具，諸路告功。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, relevant offices said land-grant pasture expansion — the law was complete and regulations drawn up; various circuits reported achievements.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, officials reported that land-grant pasture expansion regulations were complete and various circuits reported their achievements.

sentences.zh: 乃下諸路春秋集教，以備選用。

translations.literal: Spring and autumn collective training was then dispatched to the various circuits for selection and use.
translations.idiomatic: Spring and autumn collective training was then ordered across the circuits to prepare horses for selection.

sentences.zh: 令下，奉行之者益力。

translations.literal: Once the order was issued, those implementing it redoubled their efforts.
translations.idiomatic: Once the order was issued, implementation intensified.

sentences.zh: 蔡京既罷政，新用事者更言其不便。

translations.literal: Once Cai Jing was removed from power, the newly empowered again spoke of its inconvenience.
translations.idiomatic: After Cai Jing was removed from power, the newly empowered again criticized the policy as impractical.

sentences.zh: 宣和二年，詔罷政和二年以來給地牧馬條令，收見馬以給軍，應牧田及置監處並如舊制。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuanhe, it was decreed to abolish land-grant pasture horse regulations since the second year of Zhenghe; existing horses were collected to supply the army; pasture lands and superintendency sites all reverted to the old system.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xuanhe (1120), land-grant pasture horse regulations since Zhenghe were abolished. Existing horses were collected for the army, and pasture lands and superintendency sites reverted to the old system.

sentences.zh: 又復東平監。

translations.literal: The Dongping Superintendency was again restored.
translations.idiomatic: The Dongping Superintendency was restored again.

sentences.zh: 凡諸監興罷不一，而沙苑監獨不廢。

translations.literal: Superintendencies were established and abolished inconsistently, but the Shayuan Superintendency alone was never abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Superintendencies were established and abolished inconsistently, but Shayuan alone was never abolished.

sentences.zh: 自給地牧馬之法罷，三年而復行。

translations.literal: From abolition of the land-grant pasture horse method, three years later it was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Three years after the land-grant pasture horse policy was abolished, it was restored.

sentences.zh: 時牧田已多所給占，乃詔見管及已拘收，如官司輒復請占者，以違制論。

translations.literal: At the time much pasture land had already been granted and occupied; it was decreed that current holdings and already confiscated lands — if officials again requested occupation — would be prosecuted for violating regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Much pasture land had already been granted and occupied, and officials who again requested occupation of current or confiscated holdings would be prosecuted for violating regulations.

sentences.zh: 六年，又詔立賞格，應牧馬通一路及三千匹，州通縣及一千，縣及三百，其提點刑獄、守令各遷一官，倍者更減磨勘年。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, reward standards were again established: for pasture horses reaching three thousand for a whole circuit, one thousand for a prefecture and its counties, three hundred for a county — judicial inspectors and prefectural officials each advanced one rank; double amounts further reduced merit-review years.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, reward standards were established: three thousand horses for a whole circuit, one thousand for a prefecture and its counties, or three hundred for a county earned judicial inspectors and prefectural officials one rank advancement, with double amounts further reducing merit-review years.

sentences.zh: 於是諸路應募牧馬者為戶八萬七千六百有奇，為馬二萬三千五百。

translations.literal: Thereupon volunteer pasture horse households across circuits numbered eighty-seven thousand six hundred odd, horses twenty-three thousand five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Volunteer pasture horse households across the circuits totaled more than eighty-seven thousand six hundred, raising twenty-three thousand five hundred horses.

sentences.zh: 既推賞如上詔，而兵部長貳亦以兼總八路馬政遷官。

translations.literal: After rewards were distributed as above, Ministry of War chiefs and deputies also received rank advancement for jointly overseeing horse policy across eight circuits.
translations.idiomatic: After rewards were distributed as ordered, Ministry of War chiefs and deputies also received rank advancement for jointly overseeing horse policy across eight circuits.

sentences.zh: 然北方有事，而馬政亦急矣。

translations.literal: Yet trouble arose in the north, and horse administration became urgent as well.
translations.idiomatic: Yet with trouble in the north, horse administration had become urgent as well.

sentences.zh: 靖康元年，左丞李綱言：「祖宗以來，擇陝西、河東、河北美水草高涼之地，置監凡三十六所，比年廢罷殆盡。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingkang, Left Vice Grand Councillor Li Gang said: "Since the founding ancestors, fine lands with good water, grass, and high cool terrain in Shaanxi, Hedong, and Hebei were selected — thirty-six superintendencies established in all. In recent years abolitions have nearly eliminated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jingkang (1126), Left Vice Grand Councillor Li Gang argued: "Since the founding ancestors, thirty-six superintendencies had been established on fine, cool, well-watered lands in Shaanxi, Hedong, and Hebei. In recent years they have been nearly all abolished.

sentences.zh: 民間雜養以充役，官吏便文以塞責，而馬無復善者。

translations.literal: Among the people horses were miscellaneously raised to fill quotas; officials used convenient documents to satisfy responsibility — and no good horses remained.
translations.idiomatic: Civilians raised horses haphazardly to fill quotas while officials used paperwork to satisfy responsibility, and no good horses remained.

sentences.zh: 今諸軍闕馬者太半，宜復舊制，權時之宜，括天下馬，量給其直，不旬日間，則數萬之馬，猶可具也。」

translations.literal: Now the various armies lack horses in more than half their strength; the old system should be restored as a timely measure — register all horses under heaven, pay fair prices — within ten days, tens of thousands of horses can still be assembled."
translations.idiomatic: Now more than half the armies lack horses. The old system should be restored as a timely measure: register all horses nationwide and pay fair prices. Within ten days, tens of thousands of horses could still be assembled."

sentences.zh: 然時已不能盡行其說矣。

translations.literal: Yet at the time his proposal could not be fully implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Yet at the time his proposal could not be fully implemented.

sentences.zh: 保甲養馬者，自熙寧五年始。

translations.literal: Baojia horse rearing began in the fifth year of Xining.
translations.idiomatic: Baojia horse rearing began in the fifth year of Xining (1072).

sentences.zh: 先是，中書省、樞密院議其事於上前，文彥博、吳充言：「國馬宜不可闕。

translations.literal: Previously, the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs discussed the matter before the emperor; Wen Yanbo and Wu Chong said: "State horses should not be lacking.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs discussed the matter before the emperor. Wen Yanbo and Wu Chong argued: "State horses must not be lacking.

sentences.zh: 今法，馬死者責償，恐非民願。」

translations.literal: Under the current law, dead horses require compensation — I fear this is not the people's wish."
translations.idiomatic: Under the current law, compensation is required for dead horses, which civilians may not willingly accept."

sentences.zh: 安石以為令下而京畿投牒者已千五百戶，決非出於驅迫，持論益堅。

translations.literal: Anshi held that once the order was issued, one thousand five hundred households in the capital districts had already submitted petitions — certainly not from coercion — and held his argument more firmly.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi countered that fifteen hundred capital-district households had already volunteered once the order was issued, certainly not from coercion, and held his position more firmly.

sentences.zh: 五月，詔開封府界諸縣保甲願牧馬者聽，仍以陝西所市馬選給之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, it was decreed that Kaifeng capital-district counties' baojia units willing to pasture horses were permitted; Shaanxi purchased horses would still be selected and given.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Kaifeng capital-district baojia units willing to pasture horses were permitted to do so, with horses selected from Shaanxi purchases.

sentences.zh: 六年，曾布等承詔上其條約：凡五路義勇保甲願養馬者，戶一匹，物力高願養二匹者聽，皆以監牧見馬給之，或官與其直令自市，毋或強與。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Zeng Bu and others received the decree and submitted their regulations: for all five circuits' volunteer baojia willing to raise horses — one per household, those of high property willing to raise two permitted — all given superintendency horses on hand, or the government gives the price for self-purchase; none shall be forcibly assigned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Zeng Bu and others submitted regulations: volunteer baojia in all five circuits could raise one horse per household, or two if willing and of sufficient means. Horses would be supplied from superintendency stock or purchase price paid for self-acquisition, with no forced assignment.

sentences.zh: 府界毋過三千匹，五路毋過五千匹。

translations.literal: Capital district not exceeding three thousand; five circuits not exceeding five thousand.
translations.idiomatic: The capital district was capped at three thousand horses and the five circuits at five thousand.

sentences.zh: 襲逐盜賊外，乘越三百里者有禁。

translations.literal: Beyond pursuing bandits, riding beyond three hundred li was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond pursuing bandits, riding beyond three hundred li was prohibited.

sentences.zh: 在府界者，免體量草二百五十束，加給以錢布；

translations.literal: In the capital district, exemption from two hundred fifty bundles of assessed hay, with additional cash and cloth given;
translations.idiomatic: In the capital district, breeders were exempted from two hundred fifty bundles of assessed hay and given additional cash and cloth;

sentences.zh: 在五路者，歲免折變緣納錢。

translations.literal: in the five circuits, annual exemption from conversion and supplementary payment cash.
translations.idiomatic: in the five circuits, they received annual exemption from conversion and supplementary payment obligations.

sentences.zh: 三等以上，十戶為一保；

translations.literal: Third rank and above — ten households form one bao;
translations.idiomatic: Households of third rank and above formed bao units of ten households;

sentences.zh: 四等以下，十戶為一社，以待病斃逋償者。

translations.literal: fourth rank and below — ten households form one she, to cover sick, dead, and absconded compensation.
translations.idiomatic: households of fourth rank and below formed she units of ten households to share liability for sick, dead, or absconded horses.

sentences.zh: 保戶馬斃，保戶獨償之；

translations.literal: If a bao household's horse dies, bao households compensate alone;
translations.idiomatic: If a bao household's horse died, bao households compensated alone;

sentences.zh: 社戶馬斃，社戶半償之。

translations.literal: if a she household's horse dies, she households compensate half.
translations.idiomatic: if a she household's horse died, she households compensated half.

sentences.zh: 歲一閱其肥瘠，禁苛留者。

translations.literal: Once per year inspect fatness and leanness; prohibit harsh detention.
translations.idiomatic: Horses were inspected annually for condition, and harsh detention was prohibited.

sentences.zh: 凡十四條，先從府界頒焉。

translations.literal: Fourteen articles in all — first promulgated in the capital district.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen articles in all were first promulgated in the capital district.

sentences.zh: 五路委監司、經畧司、州縣更度之。

translations.literal: The five circuits entrusted supervisory commissions, frontier commissions, and prefectures and counties to reassess.
translations.idiomatic: The five circuits were entrusted to supervisory commissions, frontier commissions, and prefectural officials for reassessment.

sentences.zh: 於是保甲養馬行於諸路矣。

translations.literal: Thereupon baojia horse rearing was implemented across the various circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Baojia horse rearing was then implemented across the various circuits.

sentences.zh: 時河東騎軍馬萬一千餘匹，番戍率十年一周。

translations.literal: At the time Hedong cavalry horses numbered more than eleven thousand; frontier rotation averaged one cycle per ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong cavalry then numbered more than eleven thousand horses, with frontier rotation averaging one cycle every ten years.

sentences.zh: 議欲省費，乃行《五路義勇保甲養馬法》。

translations.literal: Discussing expense reduction, the Five Circuits Volunteer Baojia Horse-Rearing Law was implemented.
translations.idiomatic: To reduce expenses, the Five Circuits Volunteer Baojia Horse-Rearing Law was implemented.

sentences.zh: 兵部言：「 河東正軍馬九千五百匹，請權罷官給，以義勇保甲馬五千補之以合額。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War said: " Hedong regular army horses nine thousand five hundred — I request temporarily suspending government supply, using five thousand volunteer baojia horses to supplement to full quota.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War proposed: "Hedong's nine thousand five hundred regular army horses — temporarily suspend government supply and supplement with five thousand volunteer baojia horses to meet quota.

sentences.zh: 俟正軍馬不及五千，始行給配。」

translations.literal: Wait until regular army horses fall below five thousand before resuming allocation."
translations.idiomatic: Resume government allocation only when regular army horses fall below five thousand."

sentences.zh: 下中書、樞密院。

translations.literal: Sent to the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was sent to the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 樞密院以為：「官養一馬，歲為錢二十七千。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Military Affairs held: "Government-reared one horse costs twenty-seven thousand cash per year.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Military Affairs argued: "Government-reared horses cost twenty-seven thousand cash per year each.

sentences.zh: 民養一馬，才免折變緣納錢六千五百，折米而輸其直，為錢十四千四百，餘皆出於民，決非所願。

translations.literal: Civilian-reared one horse — only exempt from six thousand five hundred conversion and supplementary payment cash; converted to grain and paying the price is fourteen thousand four hundred cash — the rest all from the people; certainly not their wish.
translations.idiomatic: Civilian-reared horses save only six thousand five hundred in conversion and supplementary payments, worth fourteen thousand four hundred when converted to grain — the rest borne by civilians, certainly not willingly.

sentences.zh: 況減軍馬五千匹，邊防事宜何所取備？

translations.literal: Moreover, reducing army horses by five thousand — what will supply frontier defense needs?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, reducing army horses by five thousand — what would supply frontier defense needs?

sentences.zh: 若存官軍馬如故，漸令民間從便牧馬，不以五千為限，於理為可。」

translations.literal: If government army horses remain as before, gradually allowing civilians to pasture horses at convenience, not limited to five thousand — this is reasonable."
translations.idiomatic: If government army horses remain as before, gradually allowing civilian pasture without a five-thousand limit would be reasonable."

sentences.zh: 中書謂：「官養一馬，以中價率之，為錢二十七千。

translations.literal: The Secretariat said: "Government-reared one horse, calculated at average price, is twenty-seven thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat countered: "Government-reared horses cost twenty-seven thousand cash each at average price.

sentences.zh: 募民牧養，可省雜費八萬餘緡。

translations.literal: Recruiting civilians to pasture and rear can save more than eighty thousand strings in miscellaneous expenses.
translations.idiomatic: Recruiting civilians to pasture horses could save more than eighty thousand strings in miscellaneous expenses.

sentences.zh: 計前二年官馬死，倍於保甲馬。

translations.literal: Calculating the previous two years, government horse deaths doubled baojia horse deaths.
translations.idiomatic: Over the previous two years, government horse deaths had doubled baojia horse deaths.

sentences.zh: 而保甲有馬，可以習戰禦盜，公私兩便。」

translations.literal: Moreover, baojia with horses can practice warfare and repel bandits — convenient for both public and private."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, baojia with horses could train for combat and repel bandits, benefiting both state and civilians."

sentences.zh: 帝卒從樞密院議。

translations.literal: The emperor ultimately followed the Bureau of Military Affairs proposal.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ultimately sided with the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 九年，京畿保甲養馬者罷給錢布，止免輸草而增馬數。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, capital-district baojia horse rearers ceased receiving cash and cloth; only hay payment exemption remained while horse numbers increased.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, capital-district baojia horse rearers ceased receiving cash and cloth, retaining only hay payment exemption while horse numbers increased.

sentences.zh: 元豐六年，取河東路保甲十分之二以教騎戰，且以本路鹽息錢給之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yuanfeng, two tenths of Hedong circuit baojia were selected for cavalry combat training, funded by the circuit's salt interest revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Yuanfeng (1083), two tenths of Hedong baojia were selected for cavalry combat training, funded by the circuit's salt interest revenue.

sentences.zh: 每二十五千令市一馬，仍以五年為限。

translations.literal: Twenty-five thousand per horse for purchase, still with a five-year limit.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-five thousand cash was allocated per horse for purchase, with a five-year deadline.

sentences.zh: 七年，詔京東、西路保甲免教閱，每都保養馬五十匹，匹給錢十千，限京東以十年，京西十五年而數足。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, it was decreed that eastern and western Jing baojia be exempt from drill review; each dubao rear fifty horses, ten thousand cash per horse; eastern Jing limited to ten years, western Jing fifteen years to reach quota.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, eastern and western Jing baojia were exempted from drill review. Each dubao was to rear fifty horses at ten thousand cash per horse, with ten years to reach quota in eastern Jing and fifteen in western Jing.

sentences.zh: 置提舉保甲馬官，京西以呂公雅，京東以霍翔領之。

translations.literal: Baojia horse commissioners-in-chief were established — western Jing under Lü Gongya, eastern Jing under Huo Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: Baojia horse commissioners were appointed: Lü Gongya for western Jing and Huo Xiang for eastern Jing.

sentences.zh: 罷鄉村物力養馬之令，養戶馬者免保甲馬，皆翔所陳也。

translations.literal: The order for rural property-based horse rearing was abolished; those rearing household horses were exempt from baojia horses — all proposed by Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: The order for rural property-based horse rearing was abolished, and household horse rearers were exempt from baojia obligations — all proposed by Huo Xiang.

sentences.zh: 翔及公雅既領提舉事，多所建白。

translations.literal: Once Xiang and Gongya took charge of the commission, they made many proposals.
translations.idiomatic: Once in charge, Huo Xiang and Lü Gongya made many proposals.

sentences.zh: 請借常平錢，每路五萬緡，付州縣出息，以賞馬之充肥及孳息者。

translations.literal: They requested borrowing Ever-Normal Granary funds — fifty thousand strings per circuit — given to prefectures and counties for interest, to reward horses that were well-fed and breeding.
translations.idiomatic: They requested borrowing fifty thousand strings of Ever-Normal Granary funds per circuit for prefectures and counties to lend at interest, rewarding well-fed and breeding horses.

sentences.zh: 願以私馬印為保馬者聽。

translations.literal: Those willing to have private horses branded as guaranteed horses were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Those willing to have private horses branded as guaranteed horses were permitted.

sentences.zh: 養馬至三匹，蠲役外，每疋許次丁一人贖杖罪之非侵損於人者。

translations.literal: Raising up to three horses — beyond corvée exemption, for each horse one secondary male adult was permitted to redeem beating-punishment crimes not involving harm to others.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond corvée exemption, rearing up to three horses allowed one secondary male adult per horse to redeem non-injury beating offenses.

sentences.zh: 詔悉從之。

translations.literal: The decree approved all.
translations.idiomatic: All proposals were approved.

sentences.zh: 公雅又令每都歲市二十匹，限十五年者促為二年半。

translations.literal: Gongya further ordered each dubao purchase twenty horses per year, compressing the fifteen-year limit to two and a half years.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Gongya further ordered each dubao to purchase twenty horses per year, compressing the fifteen-year deadline to two and a half years.

sentences.zh: 京西不產馬，民貧乏益不堪，上慮有司責數過多，百姓未喻上意，詔如元令，稍增其數。

translations.literal: Western Jing does not produce horses; the people were poor and increasingly unable to bear it. The emperor feared officials demanded excessive numbers and the people did not understand his intent; it was decreed to follow the original order with slightly increased numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Western Jing did not produce horses, and impoverished civilians could not bear the burden. Fearing officials demanded too much, the emperor ordered a return to the original quotas with slight increases.

sentences.zh: 公雅乃請每都歲市八匹，限以八年，山縣限以十年。

translations.literal: Gongya then requested each dubao purchase eight horses per year, limited to eight years; mountain counties limited to ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Gongya then requested eight horses per dubao per year, with an eight-year deadline and ten years for mountain counties.

sentences.zh: 翔又奏本路馬已及萬匹，請令諸縣弓手各養一匹，以贖失捕之罪。

translations.literal: Xiang further memorialized that his circuit's horses already reached ten thousand; he requested each county's archer-soldiers raise one horse each to redeem failure-to-capture offenses.
translations.idiomatic: Huo Xiang further reported that his circuit already had ten thousand horses and requested each county archer-soldier raise one horse to redeem failure-to-capture offenses.

sentences.zh: 哲宗嗣位，言新法之不便者，以保馬為急。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhezong succeeded to the throne, those speaking of new law inconveniences prioritized guaranteed horses.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhezong succeeded to the throne, critics of the new laws prioritized abolishing guaranteed horses.

sentences.zh: 乃詔曰：「京東、西保馬，期限極寬。

translations.literal: Thereupon it was decreed: "Eastern and western Jing guaranteed horses — the deadline is extremely generous.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Eastern and western Jing guaranteed horses had extremely generous deadlines.

sentences.zh: 有司不務循守，遂致煩擾。

translations.literal: Officials did not diligently follow and preserve them, thus causing harassment.
translations.idiomatic: Officials failed to follow them diligently, causing harassment.

sentences.zh: 先帝已嘗手詔詰責，今猶未能遵守。

translations.literal: The late emperor had already handwritten edicts reprimanding this; still they cannot comply.
translations.idiomatic: The late emperor had already reprimanded this by handwritten edict, yet compliance remained lacking.

sentences.zh: 其兩路市馬年限並如元詔。」

translations.literal: Both circuits' horse purchase deadlines shall follow the original decree."
translations.idiomatic: Both circuits' horse purchase deadlines were restored to the original decree."

sentences.zh: 尋又詔以兩路保馬分配諸軍，餘數付太僕寺，不堪支配者斥還民戶而責官直。

translations.literal: Soon it was further decreed that both circuits' guaranteed horses be allocated to the various armies; remainder sent to the Court of the Imperial Stud; those unsuitable for assignment returned to civilian households with official price demanded.
translations.idiomatic: Soon both circuits' guaranteed horses were allocated to the armies, with the remainder sent to the Court of the Imperial Stud. Unsuitable horses were returned to civilians with official compensation demanded.

sentences.zh: 翔、公雅皆以罪去，而保馬遂罷。

translations.literal: Xiang and Gongya were both removed for offenses, and guaranteed horses were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Huo Xiang and Lü Gongya were both removed for offenses, and guaranteed horses were abolished.

sentences.zh: 戶馬者，慶曆中，嘗詔河北民戶以物力養馬，以備官買。

translations.literal: Household horses — during Qingli, it was decreed that Hebei civilian households raise horses by property assessment to supply government purchase.
translations.idiomatic: Household horses — during the Qingli era, Hebei civilians were ordered to raise horses based on property assessment to supply government purchase.

sentences.zh: 熙寧二年，河北察訪使曾孝寬以為言，始參考行之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xining, Hebei Investigation Commissioner Zeng Xiokuan spoke of it, and reference implementation began.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xining (1069), Hebei Investigation Commissioner Zeng Xiokuan raised the idea, and reference implementation began.

sentences.zh: 是時，諸監既廢，仰給市馬，而義勇保甲馬復從官給，朝廷以乏馬為憂。

translations.literal: At the time superintendencies were abolished, relying on purchased horses, while volunteer baojia horses again came from government supply — the court worried about horse shortage.
translations.idiomatic: Superintendencies had been abolished, leaving the court reliant on purchased horses while volunteer baojia horses again came from government supply. The court worried about horse shortages.

sentences.zh: 元豐三年春，以王拱辰之請，詔開封府界、京東西、河北、陝西、河東路州縣戶各計資產市馬，坊郭家產及三千緡、鄉村五千緡、若坊郭鄉村通及三千緡以上者，各養一馬，增倍者馬亦如之，至三疋止。

translations.literal: In spring of the third year of Yuanfeng, at Wang Gongchen's request, it was decreed that Kaifeng capital district, eastern and western Jing, Hebei, Shaanxi, and Hedong circuit prefecture and county households each calculate assets to purchase horses: urban property reaching three thousand strings, rural five thousand strings, or combined urban-rural three thousand strings and above — each raise one horse; doubled assets, horses likewise; up to three maximum.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the third year of Yuanfeng (1080), at Wang Gongchen's request, households in the Kaifeng capital district, eastern and western Jing, Hebei, Shaanxi, and Hedong were ordered to raise horses based on assets: one horse for urban property of three thousand strings, rural five thousand, or combined three thousand; doubled assets meant doubled horses, up to three maximum.

sentences.zh: 馬以四尺三寸以上，齒限八歲以下，及十五歲則更市如初，籍於提舉司。

translations.literal: Horses must be four chi three cun and above; age limit eight years and below; at fifteen years repurchase as initially; registered with the commissioner-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Horses had to be at least four chi three cun in height and eight years old or younger, with repurchase required at fifteen years. All were registered with the commissioner-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 於是諸道各上其數，開封府界四千六百九十四，河北東路六百一十五，西路八百五十四，秦鳳等路六百四十二，永興路一千五百四十六，河東路三百六十六，京東東路七百一十七，西路九百二十二，京西南路五百九十，北路七百一十六。

translations.literal: Thereupon each circuit reported its numbers: Kaifeng capital district four thousand six hundred ninety-four; Hebei East Circuit six hundred fifteen; West Circuit eight hundred fifty-four; Qinfeng and other circuits six hundred forty-two; Yongxing Circuit one thousand five hundred forty-six; Hedong Circuit three hundred sixty-six; eastern Jing East Circuit seven hundred seventeen; West Circuit nine hundred twenty-two; southwestern Jing five hundred ninety; North Circuit seven hundred sixteen.
translations.idiomatic: Each circuit then reported its totals: Kaifeng capital district four thousand six hundred ninety-four; Hebei East six hundred fifteen; Hebei West eight hundred fifty-four; Qinfeng and others six hundred forty-two; Yongxing one thousand five hundred forty-six; Hedong three hundred sixty-six; eastern Jing East seven hundred seventeen; Jing West nine hundred twenty-two; southwestern Jing five hundred ninety; Jing North seven hundred sixteen.

sentences.zh: 時初立法，上慮商賈乘時高直以病民，命以群牧司驍騎以上千疋出市，以平其直。

translations.literal: When the law was first enacted, the emperor feared merchants would seize the moment for high prices to harm the people; he ordered one thousand Xiao-qi and above horses from the Herd Pasture Bureau released to market to stabilize prices.
