translations.idiomatic: When the law was first enacted, fearing merchants would inflate prices, the emperor ordered one thousand Xiao-qi and above horses from the Herd Pasture Bureau released to market to stabilize prices.

sentences.zh: 熙寧中，嘗令德順軍蕃部養馬，帝問其利害。

translations.literal: During Xining, Tangut tribes at Deshun Army were once ordered to raise horses; the emperor asked about advantages and disadvantages.
translations.idiomatic: During Xining, Tangut tribes at Deshun Army were once ordered to raise horses, and the emperor asked about the advantages and disadvantages.

sentences.zh: 王安石謂：「今坊、監以五百緡得一馬，若委之熙河蕃部，當不至重費。

translations.literal: Wang Anshi said: "Now wards and superintendencies obtain one horse for five hundred strings; if entrusted to Xixi Tangut tribes, it should not be excessively costly.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi argued: "Wards and superintendencies now pay five hundred strings per horse. Entrusting this to Xixi Tangut tribes should not be excessively costly.

sentences.zh: 蕃部地宜馬，且以畜牧為生，誠為便利。」

translations.literal: Tangut lands suit horses and livestock is their livelihood — truly convenient."
translations.idiomatic: Tangut lands suit horses and livestock is their livelihood — truly convenient."

sentences.zh: 已而得駒庳劣，亡失者責償，蕃部苦之，其法尋廢。

translations.literal: Subsequently foals obtained were inferior; losses required compensation; Tangut tribes suffered — the method was soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Subsequently foals proved inferior, losses required compensation, and Tangut tribes suffered. The method was soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 至是，環慶路經畧司復言已檄諸蕃部養馬，詔閱實及格者一匹支五縑，鄜延、秦鳳、涇原路準此。

translations.literal: At this time, the Huancqing circuit frontier commission again said it had already ordered various Tangut tribes to raise horses; it was decreed that verified qualified horses receive five bolts of silk each; Yan-Yan, Qinfeng, and Jingyuan circuits followed this standard.
translations.idiomatic: The Huancqing frontier commission reported that various Tangut tribes had been ordered to raise horses. Verified qualified horses would receive five bolts of silk each, with Yan-Yan, Qinfeng, and Jingyuan circuits following the same standard.

sentences.zh: 時西方用兵，頗調戶馬以給戰騎，借者給還，死則償直。

translations.literal: At the time the west was at war; many household horses were requisitioned for war cavalry; borrowed ones returned, dead ones compensated at price.
translations.idiomatic: With war in the west, many household horses were requisitioned for war cavalry. Borrowed horses were returned; dead ones compensated at purchase price.

sentences.zh: 七年，遂詔河東、鄜延、環慶路各發戶馬二千以給正兵，河東就給本路，鄜延益以永興軍等路及京西坊郭馬，環慶益以秦鳳等路及開封府界馬。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, it was decreed that Hedong, Yan-Yan, and Huancqing circuits each dispatch two thousand household horses for regular troops; Hedong supplied from its own circuit; Yan-Yan supplemented with Yongxing Army and other circuits plus western Jing urban horses; Huancqing supplemented with Qinfeng and other circuits plus Kaifeng capital district horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Hedong, Yan-Yan, and Huancqing circuits were each ordered to dispatch two thousand household horses for regular troops. Hedong supplied from its own circuit; Yan-Yan supplemented from Yongxing Army and other circuits plus western Jing urban horses; Huancqing from Qinfeng and other circuits plus Kaifeng capital district horses.

sentences.zh: 戶馬既配兵，後遂不復補。

translations.literal: Once household horses were assigned to troops, they were never replenished afterward.
translations.idiomatic: Once household horses were assigned to troops, they were never replenished.

sentences.zh: 京東、西既更為保馬，諸路養馬指揮至八年亦罷。

translations.literal: Eastern and western Jing having switched to guaranteed horses, horse-rearing orders across circuits were also abolished by the eighth year.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern and western Jing having switched to guaranteed horses, horse-rearing orders across the circuits were abolished by the eighth year.

sentences.zh: 其後給地牧馬，則亦本於戶馬之意云。

translations.literal: Subsequently land-grant pasture horses also originated from the intent of household horses, it is said.
translations.idiomatic: Subsequently, land-grant pasture horses also originated from the intent behind household horses.

sentences.zh: 至於收市，則仍嘉祐之制，置買馬司於原渭州、德順軍，而增為招市之令。

translations.literal: As for collection and marketing, the Jiayou system was still followed — Horse Purchase Office established at Yuan and Weizhou and Deshun Army, with recruitment marketing orders added.
translations.idiomatic: For procurement and marketing, the Jiayou system was retained with a Horse Purchase Office at Yuan and Weizhou and Deshun Army, supplemented by recruitment marketing orders.

sentences.zh: 後開熙河，則更於熙河置買馬司，而以秦州買馬司隸焉。

translations.literal: Later when Xixi was opened, a Horse Purchase Office was further established at Xixi, with the Qinzhou Horse Purchase Office subordinated to it.
translations.idiomatic: When Xixi was opened, a Horse Purchase Office was established there, subordinating the Qinzhou Horse Purchase Office.

sentences.zh: 八年，遂置熙河路買馬場六，而原、渭、德順諸場皆廢。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, six Xixi circuit horse markets were established, and the Yuan, Wei, and Deshun markets were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, six Xixi circuit horse markets were established, and the Yuan, Wei, and Deshun markets were abolished.

sentences.zh: 繼又置熙河岷州、通遠軍、永寧砦等場，而德順軍置馬場亦復。

translations.literal: Subsequently markets were further established at Xixi Minzhou, Tongyuan Army, Yongning Stockade, and others; the Deshun Army horse market was also restored.
translations.idiomatic: Markets were subsequently established at Minzhou, Tongyuan Army, and Yongning Stockade in Xixi, and the Deshun Army horse market was restored.

sentences.zh: 先是，麟府路上所市馬三百，以其直增於熙河而又多羸憊，乃罷本路博易，令軍馬司自市。

translations.literal: Previously, three hundred horses purchased on the Lin-Fu circuit had prices higher than Xixi and many were weak and exhausted; the circuit's exchange trade was abolished and the Army Horse Bureau ordered to purchase on its own.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, three hundred horses purchased on the Lin-Fu circuit cost more than Xixi horses and many were weak and exhausted. The circuit's exchange trade was abolished and the Army Horse Bureau ordered to purchase independently.

sentences.zh: 時又以邊臣之議，市岢嵐、火山軍土產馬以增戰騎。

translations.literal: At the time, following frontier officials' proposal, locally bred horses from Kelan and Huoshan Army were purchased to increase war cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: At frontier officials' proposal, locally bred horses from Kelan and Huoshan Army were purchased to increase war cavalry.

sentences.zh: 既又以邊人盜馬越疆以趣利，尋皆罷之。

translations.literal: Subsequently frontier people stole horses across borders for profit; soon all were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: When frontier people began stealing horses across borders for profit, these markets were soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 自是，國馬專仰市於熙河、秦鳳矣。

translations.literal: From this, state horses relied exclusively on purchases from Xixi and Qinfeng.
translations.idiomatic: From this point, state horses relied exclusively on purchases from Xixi and Qinfeng.

sentences.zh: 熙寧七年，熙河用兵，馬道梗絕。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Xining, Xixi was at war and horse routes were cut off.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Xining (1074), war in Xixi cut off horse routes.

sentences.zh: 乃詔知成都府蔡延慶兼提舉戎、黎州買馬，以經度其事。

translations.literal: It was decreed that Chengdu Prefect Cai Yanqing also serve as commissioner-in-chief for horse purchase in Rong and Lizhou to plan the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Chengdu Prefect Cai Yanqing was ordered to also serve as commissioner-in-chief for horse purchase in Rong and Lizhou to oversee the effort.

sentences.zh: 明年，延慶言：「威、雅、嘉、瀘、文、龍州，地接烏蠻、西羌，皆產善馬。

translations.literal: The next year, Yanqing said: "Wei, Ya, Jia, Lu, Wen, and Long prefectures border the Wuman and Western Qiang — all produce fine horses.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, Yanqing reported: "Wei, Ya, Jia, Lu, Wen, and Long prefectures border the Wuman and Western Qiang and all produce fine horses.

sentences.zh: 請委知州、砦主，以錦采、茶、絹招市。」

translations.literal: I request prefects and stockade chiefs be entrusted to recruit purchase with brocade, tea, and silk."
translations.idiomatic: I request that prefects and stockade chiefs be authorized to purchase horses with brocade, tea, and silk."

sentences.zh: 未及施行，會威、茂州夷人盜邊，及西邊馬已至，八月，遂詔罷提舉戎、黎買馬。

translations.literal: Before implementation, Wei and Maozhou tribal peoples raided the border, and western horses had already arrived; in the eighth month, the Rong-Lizhou horse purchase commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Before implementation, tribal raids from Wei and Maozhou occurred and western horses had already arrived. In the eighth month, the Rong-Lizhou horse purchase commission was abolished.

sentences.zh: 元豐中，軍興乏馬。

translations.literal: During Yuanfeng, the army mobilized and horses were lacking.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanfeng era, military mobilization created a horse shortage.

sentences.zh: 六年，復命知成都呂大防同成都府、利州路轉運司，經制邊郡之可市馬者，遂制嘉州中鎮砦、雅州靈關等買馬場，而馬皆不至。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Chengdu Prefect Lü Dafang was again ordered, together with the Chengdu Prefecture and Lizhou circuit transport commission, to plan frontier prefectures suitable for horse purchase; horse markets were established at Jiazhou Zhongzhen Stockade, Yazhou Lingguan, and others — but no horses arrived.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Chengdu Prefect Lü Dafang and the Chengdu and Lizhou transport commissions were ordered to plan frontier horse markets. Markets were established at Jiazhou Zhongzhen Stockade and Yazhou Lingguan, but no horses arrived.

sentences.zh: 元祐初，乃罷之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanyou, they were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yuanyou, they were abolished.

sentences.zh: 元祐中，嘗詔以蜀馬給陝西軍，以陝西馬赴京師。

translations.literal: During Yuanyou, it was once decreed that Shu horses supply Shaanxi armies and Shaanxi horses go to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: During Yuanyou, Shu horses were ordered to supply Shaanxi armies while Shaanxi horses were sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 崇寧五年，增黎州市馬至四千疋。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chongning, Lizhou circuit horses were increased to four thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Chongning (1106), Lizhou circuit horses were increased to four thousand.

sentences.zh: 然凡雲蜀馬者，惟沈黎所市為多，其他如戎、瀘等州，歲與蠻人為市，第存優恤，數馬以給其直。

translations.literal: However, among all Shu horses, only Shenli's purchases were numerous; others such as Rong and Lu prefectures traded with tribal peoples annually, merely maintaining preferential treatment, giving a few horses for their prices.
translations.idiomatic: Among Shu horses, only Shenli's purchases were substantial. Other prefectures such as Rong and Lu traded with tribal peoples annually, offering preferential treatment and a few horses at set prices.

sentences.zh: 大觀初，又詔播州夷界巡檢楊榮，許歲市馬五十疋於南平軍，其給賜視戎州之數。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Daguan, Bozhou tribal-border patrol inspector Yang Rong was permitted to purchase fifty horses annually at Nanping Army, with grants matching Rongzhou's quota.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Daguan, Bozhou tribal-border patrol inspector Yang Rong was permitted to purchase fifty horses annually at Nanping Army at grants matching Rongzhou's quota.

sentences.zh: 熙寧中，罷券馬而專於招市，歲省三司錢二十萬緡。

translations.literal: During Xining, coupon horses were abolished in favor of recruitment marketing, saving the State Finance Commission two hundred thousand strings annually.
translations.idiomatic: During Xining, coupon horses were abolished in favor of recruitment marketing, saving the State Finance Commission two hundred thousand strings annually.

sentences.zh: 自馬不下槽出牧，三司復給芻秣之費更相補除，而三司歲償群牧者，為緡錢十萬，以增市馬。

translations.literal: Once horses no longer left mangers for pasture, the State Finance Commission again supplied fodder expenses in mutual offset; the commission annually reimbursed the Herd Pasture Bureau one hundred thousand strings to increase horse purchases.
translations.idiomatic: Once horses no longer left mangers for pasture, the State Finance Commission resumed fodder payments in mutual offset and reimbursed the Herd Pasture Bureau one hundred thousand strings annually to increase horse purchases.

sentences.zh: 券馬之罷已久，紹聖初，提舉買馬陸師閔奏復行之，令蕃漢商人願以馬結券進賣者，先從諸場驗印，各具其直給券，送太僕寺償之。

translations.literal: Coupon horses had long been abolished; at the beginning of Shaosheng, Horse Purchase Commissioner Lu Shimin memorialized to restore the practice: Tangut and Han merchants willing to sell horses on coupon first had them inspected and branded at the various markets, prices listed and coupons issued, sent to the Court of the Imperial Stud for reimbursement.
translations.idiomatic: Coupon horses had long been abolished. At the beginning of Shaosheng, Horse Purchase Commissioner Lu Shimin restored the practice: Tangut and Han merchants selling horses on coupon had them inspected and branded at markets, received price certificates, and were reimbursed by the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 其說以為券馬既盛行，則綱馬可罷。

translations.literal: The argument held that once coupon horses flourished, convoy horses could be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The argument was that once coupon horses flourished, convoy horses could be abolished.

sentences.zh: 行之三年，樞密院言券馬死不及厘，而綱馬之死十倍。

translations.literal: After three years, the Bureau of Military Affairs said coupon horse deaths did not reach one tenth of one percent, while convoy horse deaths were ten times higher.
translations.idiomatic: After three years, the Bureau of Military Affairs reported coupon horse mortality below one tenth of one percent, while convoy horse deaths were ten times higher.

sentences.zh: 乃賜師閔金帛，加集賢修撰，以賞其功。

translations.literal: Shimin was granted gold and silk and promoted to Hanlin Compiler to reward his achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Shimin was granted gold and silk and promoted to Hanlin Compiler to reward his achievement.

sentences.zh: 時議既不以券馬為是，主管買馬閻令亦言其枉費。

translations.literal: Contemporary opinion no longer approved coupon horses; Horse Purchase Director Yan Ling also said they wasted resources.
translations.idiomatic: Contemporary opinion no longer approved coupon horses, and Horse Purchase Director Yan Ling also called them wasteful.

sentences.zh: 然曾布力行之。

translations.literal: Yet Zeng Bu forcefully implemented them.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Zeng Bu forcefully maintained the policy.

sentences.zh: 崇寧中，乃詔買馬一遵元豐法。

translations.literal: During Chongning, horse purchase was ordered to follow the Yuanfeng law entirely.
translations.idiomatic: During Chongning, horse purchase was ordered to follow the Yuanfeng system entirely.

sentences.zh: 市馬之官，自嘉祐中，始以陝西轉運使兼本路監牧買馬事，後又以制置陝西解鹽官同主之。

translations.literal: Horse purchase officials — from Jiayou, the Shaanxi transport commissioner first concurrently oversaw the circuit's pasture and horse purchase affairs; later the Shaanxi Jie-Salt Commissioner-in-Chief also jointly managed them.
translations.idiomatic: From Jiayou, the Shaanxi transport commissioner first concurrently oversaw pasture and horse purchase affairs; later the Shaanxi Jie-Salt Commissioner-in-Chief joined in management.

sentences.zh: 熙寧中，始置提舉熙河路買馬，命知熙州王韶為之，而以提點刑獄為同提舉。

translations.literal: During Xining, the Xixi circuit Horse Purchase Commissioner-in-Chief was first established, with Xizhou Prefect Wang Shao appointed, and the judicial inspector as co-commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: During Xining, the Xixi circuit Horse Purchase Commissioner was established with Xizhou Prefect Wang Shao appointed and the judicial inspector as co-commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八年，提舉茶場李杞言：「賣茶買馬，固為一事。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Tea Market Commissioner Li Qi said: "Selling tea and buying horses are inherently one matter.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Tea Market Commissioner Li Qi argued: "Selling tea and buying horses are inherently one matter.

sentences.zh: 乞同提舉買馬。」

translations.literal: I request co-commissionership for horse purchase."
translations.idiomatic: I request co-commissionership for horse purchase."

sentences.zh: 詔如其請。

translations.literal: The decree approved his request.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 十年，又置群牧行司，以往來督市馬者。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, a Herd Pasture Mobile Bureau was also established to supervise horse purchases back and forth.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, a Herd Pasture Mobile Bureau was established to supervise horse purchases.

sentences.zh: 元豐三年，復罷為提舉買馬監牧司。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanfeng, it was again abolished and reorganized as the Horse Purchase and Pasture Superintendency.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yuanfeng (1080), it was reorganized as the Horse Purchase and Pasture Superintendency.

sentences.zh: 四年，群牧判官郭茂恂言：「承詔議專以茶市馬，以物帛市穀，而並茶馬為一司。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Herd Pasture administrative judge Guo Maoxun said: "Receiving the decree to discuss using tea exclusively for horse purchase, using goods and silk for grain purchase, and merging tea and horse into one bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Herd Pasture administrative judge Guo Maoxun reported: "Per the decree to use tea exclusively for horse purchase, goods and silk for grain, and merge tea and horse affairs into one bureau.

sentences.zh: 臣聞頃時以茶易馬，兼用金帛，亦聽其便。

translations.literal: I have heard that recently tea was exchanged for horses with gold and silk also used as convenient.
translations.idiomatic: I understand that recently tea was exchanged for horses with gold and silk also permitted as convenient.

sentences.zh: 近歲事局既分，專用銀絹、錢鈔，非蕃部所欲。

translations.literal: In recent years affairs were divided; exclusively using silver, silk, and paper money — not what tribal departments desire.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years, with affairs divided, exclusive use of silver, silk, and paper money was not what tribal departments desired.

sentences.zh: 且茶馬二者，事實相須。

translations.literal: Moreover, tea and horses — the two matters in fact depend on each other.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, tea and horses in fact depend on each other.

sentences.zh: 請如詔便。」

translations.literal: I request following the decree as convenient."
translations.idiomatic: I request following the decree."

sentences.zh: 奏可。

translations.literal: The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 仍詔專以雅州名山茶為易馬用。

translations.literal: It was further decreed that Yazhou Mingshan tea be used exclusively for horse exchange.
translations.idiomatic: Yazhou Mingshan tea was decreed for exclusive use in horse exchange.

sentences.zh: 自是蕃馬至者稍眾。

translations.literal: From this, tribal horses arriving gradually increased.
translations.idiomatic: Tribal horses arriving gradually increased thereafter.

sentences.zh: 六年，買馬司復罷兼茶事。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the Horse Purchase Bureau again ceased concurrent tea affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, the Horse Purchase Bureau again ceased concurrent tea affairs.

sentences.zh: 七年，更詔以買馬隸經制熙河財用司。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, it was further decreed that horse purchase be subordinate to the Xixi Finance Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, horse purchase was subordinated to the Xixi Finance Commission.

sentences.zh: 經制司罷，乃復故。

translations.literal: When the finance commission was abolished, the former arrangement was restored.
translations.idiomatic: When the finance commission was abolished, the former arrangement was restored.

sentences.zh: 自李杞建議，始於提舉茶事兼買馬，其後二職分合不一。

translations.literal: From Li Qi's proposal, the tea commissioner first concurrently handled horse purchase; afterward the two posts were divided and merged inconsistently.
translations.idiomatic: From Li Qi's proposal, the tea commissioner first concurrently handled horse purchase; afterward the two posts were divided and merged inconsistently.

sentences.zh: 崇寧四年，詔曰：「神宗皇帝厲精庶政，經營熙河路茶馬司以致國馬，法制大備。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chongning, it was decreed: "Emperor Shenzong diligently refined general administration and established the Xixi Tea-Horse Bureau to obtain state horses — regulations were fully complete.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Chongning (1105), an edict declared: "Emperor Shenzong diligently refined administration and established the Xixi Tea-Horse Bureau to obtain state horses, with fully complete regulations.

sentences.zh: 其後監司欲侵奪其利以助糴買，故茶利不專，而馬不敷額。

translations.literal: Afterward supervisory commissions wished to seize its profits to assist grain purchase, so tea profits were not exclusive and horses did not meet quota.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward supervisory commissions seized its profits for grain purchase, so tea profits were no longer exclusive and horses fell short of quota.

sentences.zh: 近雖更立條約，令茶馬司總運茶博馬之職，猶慮有司苟於目前近利，不顧悠久深害。

translations.literal: Recently although new treaties were established, ordering the Tea-Horse Bureau to overall manage tea transport and horse trade, there is still concern officials seek immediate near-term profit without regard for long-term deep harm.
translations.idiomatic: Although new treaties ordered the Tea-Horse Bureau to manage tea transport and horse trade, there remained concern that officials would seek immediate profit without regard for long-term harm.

sentences.zh: 三省其謹守已行，毋輒變亂元豐成法。」

translations.literal: The three secretariats should carefully preserve what is implemented — do not rashly alter and disrupt the Yuanfeng established law."
translations.idiomatic: The three secretariats must carefully preserve current practice and not rashly alter the Yuanfeng established system."

sentences.zh: 自是職任始一。

translations.literal: From this, duties were unified.
translations.idiomatic: From this point, duties were unified.

sentences.zh: 市馬之數，以時增損。

translations.literal: Horse purchase numbers increased and decreased according to the times.
translations.idiomatic: Horse purchase quotas increased and decreased according to the times.

sentences.zh: 初，原、渭、德順凡三歲共市馬萬七千一百匹，而群牧判官王誨言：「嘉祐六年以前，秦州券馬歲至者萬五千匹。

translations.literal: Initially, Yuan, Wei, and Deshun over three years jointly purchased seventeen thousand one hundred horses; Herd Pasture administrative judge Wang Hui said: "Before the sixth year of Jiayou, Qinzhou coupon horses annually arriving numbered fifteen thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, Yuan, Wei, and Deshun purchased seventeen thousand one hundred horses over three years. Herd Pasture administrative judge Wang Hui reported: "Before the sixth year of Jiayou, Qinzhou coupon horses averaged fifteen thousand annually.

sentences.zh: 今券馬法壞，請令增市，而優使臣之賞。」

translations.literal: Now the coupon horse law is broken — I request increased purchases and enhanced rewards for envoy-officials."
translations.idiomatic: Now the coupon horse system is broken. I request increased purchases and enhanced rewards for envoy-officials."

sentences.zh: 熙寧三年，乃詔涇、原、渭、德順歲買萬匹，三年而會之，以十分為率，及六分七厘者進一官，餘分又析為三等，每增一等者更減磨勘年。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xining, it was decreed that Jing, Yuan, Wei, and Deshun purchase ten thousand annually; after three years totals were compared — taking ten parts as standard, reaching six parts seven tenths earned one rank advancement; remaining parts divided into three grades, each grade increase further reduced merit-review years.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xining (1070), Jing, Yuan, Wei, and Deshun were ordered to purchase ten thousand horses annually. After three years, officials reaching sixty-seven percent of quota earned one rank advancement, with further graded merit-review reductions.

sentences.zh: 自是，市馬之賞始優矣。

translations.literal: From this, horse purchase rewards began to be generous.
translations.idiomatic: Horse purchase rewards became generous from this point.

sentences.zh: 時誨上《馬政條約》，詔頒行之。

translations.literal: At the time Hui submitted the Horse Administration Regulations; the decree ordered their promulgation.
translations.idiomatic: Hui submitted the Horse Administration Regulations, which were promulgated by decree.

sentences.zh: 其後，熙河市馬歲增至萬五千。

translations.literal: Afterward, Xixi circuit horse purchases annually increased to fifteen thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, Xixi circuit horse purchases increased to fifteen thousand annually.

sentences.zh: 紹聖中，又增至二萬匹，歲費五十萬緡。

translations.literal: During Shaosheng, they further increased to twenty thousand, costing five hundred thousand strings annually.
translations.idiomatic: During Shaosheng, purchases increased to twenty thousand horses at five hundred thousand strings annually.

sentences.zh: 後遂以為定額，特詔增市者不在此數。

translations.literal: Later this became the fixed quota; specially decreed additional purchases were not counted in this number.
translations.idiomatic: This became the fixed quota, with specially decreed additional purchases excluded.

sentences.zh: 崇寧四年，提舉程之邵、孫鼇抃以額外市戰馬及二萬匹，各遷一官。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chongning, commissioners Cheng Zhishao and Sun Aobian each purchased beyond quota more than twenty thousand war horses and each advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Chongning, commissioners Cheng Zhishao and Sun Aobian each purchased more than twenty thousand war horses beyond quota and each advanced one rank.

sentences.zh: 鼇抃仍賜三品服。

translations.literal: Aobian was additionally granted third-rank robes.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Aobian was additionally granted third-rank robes.

sentences.zh: 大觀元年，龐寅孫等又以買御前良馬及三萬疋，推恩如之邵例。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daguan, Pang Yinsun and others purchased more than thirty thousand fine horses for the imperial presence and received grace following Zhishao's precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daguan, Pang Yinsun and others purchased more than thirty thousand fine horses for the imperial presence and received rewards following Cheng Zhishao's precedent.

sentences.zh: 宣和中，宇文常、何漸等更以遵用元豐成法，省費不貲，各加職遷官。

translations.literal: During Xuanhe, Yu Wenchang, He Jian, and others further followed the Yuanfeng established law, saving incalculable expenses — each received additional posts and rank advancement.
translations.idiomatic: During Xuanhe, Yu Wenchang, He Jian, and others saved incalculable expenses by following the Yuanfeng system and each received additional posts and rank advancement.

sentences.zh: 時如此類頗眾。

translations.literal: At the time such cases were quite numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Such cases were quite numerous at the time.

sentences.zh: 賞典優濫，官屬利於多市馬，取充數而已。

translations.literal: Reward standards were excessively generous; officials profited from purchasing many horses, merely filling quotas.
translations.idiomatic: Reward standards were excessively generous; officials profited from purchasing many horses merely to fill quotas.

sentences.zh: 支配。

translations.literal: Allocation.
translations.idiomatic: Allocation.

sentences.zh: 舊制，自御馬而下，次給賜臣僚，次諸軍，而驛馬為下。

translations.literal: Under the old system, from imperial horses downward — next grants to ministers, next the various armies, with relay horses last.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system, allocation proceeded from imperial horses to ministerial grants, then the various armies, with relay horses last.

sentences.zh: 熙寧初，樞密院言：「祖宗時，臣僚任邊職者，或賜帶甲馬，示不忘疆埸之事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xining, the Bureau of Military Affairs said: "Under the founding ancestors, ministers serving frontier posts sometimes received armored horses as grants, showing they did not forget border affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xining, the Bureau of Military Affairs reported: "Under the founding ancestors, ministers serving frontier posts sometimes received armored horses, showing remembrance of border affairs.

sentences.zh: 承平日久，僥幸滋長。

translations.literal: Long peace bred opportunism.
translations.idiomatic: Long peace had bred opportunism.

sentences.zh: 請應使臣閤門祗候以上，充三路路分州軍總管、鈐轄之類，賜馬價如故，餘皆罷給。」

translations.literal: I request that envoy-officials, gate attendants, and above serving as Three Routes circuit-prefecture-army overall commanders, controllers, and the like receive horse prices as before; all others cease receiving grants."
translations.idiomatic: I request that envoy-officials and gate attendants serving as Three Routes overall commanders and controllers continue receiving horse prices as before, while all others cease receiving grants."

sentences.zh: 奏可。

translations.literal: The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 十年，群牧司又言：「去歲給安南行營及兩省、宗室、諸班直及諸軍、諸司馬總三千餘匹，未支者猶二千。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, the Herd Pasture Bureau again said: "Last year horses given to the Annan expeditionary force, both provinces, imperial clansmen, various guard direct units, various armies, and various offices totaled more than three thousand; two thousand remained undistributed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, the Herd Pasture Bureau reported: "Last year more than three thousand horses were allocated to the Annan expedition, both provinces, imperial clansmen, guard direct units, armies, and offices, with two thousand still undistributed.

sentences.zh: 請裁宗室以下所給馬，諸司停給。」

translations.literal: I request reducing horses given below imperial clansmen; various offices cease receiving grants."
translations.idiomatic: I request reducing grants below imperial clansmen and ceasing grants to various offices."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 自罷監至此，始闕馬矣。

translations.literal: From abolishing superintendencies until now, horse shortages began.
translations.idiomatic: From abolishing superintendencies until now, horse shortages had begun.

sentences.zh: 熙寧初，詔河北騎軍如陝西、河東社馬例立社，更相助錢以市馬，而遞增官直。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xining, it was decreed that Hebei cavalry establish societies following the Shaanxi and Hedong horse society precedent, mutually assisting with funds to purchase horses, with progressively increased official prices.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xining, Hebei cavalry were ordered to establish societies following the Shaanxi and Hedong precedent, mutually assisting with funds to purchase horses at progressively increased official prices.

sentences.zh: 尋出奉宸庫珠十餘萬以充其費。

translations.literal: Soon more than one hundred thousand pearls from the Fengchen Treasury were issued to cover the expense.
translations.idiomatic: Soon more than one hundred thousand pearls from the Fengchen Treasury were issued to cover the expense.

sentences.zh: 其後，陝西馬社苦於斂率。

translations.literal: Afterward, Shaanxi horse societies suffered from levies and collections.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, Shaanxi horse societies suffered from excessive levies.

sentences.zh: 元豐中，乃詔本路罷其法，更從買馬司給之。

translations.literal: During Yuanfeng, the circuit was decreed to abolish the method and instead receive supply from the Horse Purchase Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: During Yuanfeng, the circuit was ordered to abolish the method and receive supply from the Horse Purchase Bureau instead.

sentences.zh: 時又諸路置將，馬不能盡給，則給其直，而委諸將自市。

translations.literal: At the time generals were established across circuits; when horses could not all be supplied, prices were given and generals entrusted to purchase on their own.
translations.idiomatic: Generals were established across circuits; when horses could not all be supplied, cash was given and generals entrusted to purchase on their own.

sentences.zh: 其在熙河蘭會路者，即以為買馬之數。

translations.literal: For those in the Xixi Lan-Hui circuit, this counted toward horse purchase numbers.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xixi Lan-Hui circuit, this counted toward horse purchase quotas.

sentences.zh: 初，內外諸軍給馬，例不及其元額，視其闕之多寡，以分數填配。

translations.literal: Initially, inner and outer armies receiving horses typically did not reach original quotas; according to shortage amounts, fractional quotas were filled.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, inner and outer armies typically received less than their original horse quotas, with fractional allocation according to shortage levels.

sentences.zh: 元豐更立為定制，凡諸軍闕馬應給者，在京、府界、京東西、河東、陝西路無過十之七，河北路十之六。

translations.literal: Yuanfeng established a fixed system: for all armies lacking horses due for supply — capital, capital district, eastern and western Jing, Hedong, and Shaanxi circuits no more than seven tenths; Hebei circuit six tenths.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanfeng established fixed quotas: armies lacking horses would receive no more than seven tenths in the capital, capital district, eastern and western Jing, Hedong, and Shaanxi circuits, and six tenths in Hebei.

sentences.zh: 然其後諸軍闕馬者多，紹聖三年，乃詔提舉陸師閔於歲額外市馬三萬匹，給鄜延、環慶路正兵，餘支弓箭手，仍權不限分數。

translations.literal: However, afterward many armies lacked horses; in the third year of Shaosheng, Commissioner Lu Shimin was decreed to purchase thirty thousand horses beyond the annual quota, giving to Yan-Yan and Huancqing regular troops, remainder to archer-soldiers, temporarily without fractional limits.
translations.idiomatic: Many armies still lacked horses. In the third year of Shaosheng (1096), Commissioner Lu Shimin was ordered to purchase thirty thousand horses beyond the annual quota for Yan-Yan and Huancqing regular troops and archer-soldiers, temporarily without fractional limits.

sentences.zh: 宣和初，真定、中山、高陽等路乏馬，復給度僧牒，令帥臣就市，以補諸軍之闕。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xuanhe, Zhending, Zhongshan, Gaoyang, and other circuits lacked horses; monk ordination certificates were again issued for commanders to purchase locally, supplementing various armies' shortages.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xuanhe, Zhending, Zhongshan, Gaoyang, and other circuits lacked horses. Monk ordination certificates were again issued for commanders to purchase locally and supplement army shortages.

sentences.zh: 高宗紹興二年，置馬監於饒州，守卒領之，擇官田為牧地，復置提舉。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shaoxing under Emperor Gaozong, a horse superintendency was established at Raozhou, led by garrison soldiers; official land was selected as pasture; a commissioner-in-chief was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shaoxing (1132), a horse superintendency was established at Raozhou under garrison soldiers, with official land selected as pasture and a commissioner restored.

sentences.zh: 俄廢。

translations.literal: Soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: It was soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 四年，置監臨安之餘杭及南蕩。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, superintendencies were established at Lin'an's Yuhang and Nandang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, superintendencies were established at Yuhang and Nandang near Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 十九年，詔：「馬五百匹為一監，牡一而牝四。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, it was decreed: "Five hundred horses form one superintendency — one stallion to four mares.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, an edict ordered: "Five hundred horses form one superintendency — one stallion to four mares.

sentences.zh: 監為四群。

translations.literal: One superintendency forms four herds.
translations.idiomatic: Each superintendency forms four herds.

sentences.zh: 歲產駒三分及斃二分以上，有賞罰。」

translations.literal: Annual foal production of three tenths and deaths of two tenths or more — rewards and punishments apply."
translations.idiomatic: Rewards and punishments applied for annual foal production of thirty percent and deaths exceeding twenty percent."

sentences.zh: 帝謂輔臣曰：「議者言南地不宜牧馬。

translations.literal: The emperor told chief ministers: "Discussants say southern lands are unsuitable for horse pasture.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told chief ministers: "Critics say southern lands are unsuitable for horse pasture.

sentences.zh: 昨自牧養，今二三年，已得馬數百。」

translations.literal: Since pasture rearing began, in two or three years, already several hundred horses have been obtained."
translations.idiomatic: Since pasture rearing began two or three years ago, we have already obtained several hundred horses."

sentences.zh: 先是，川路所置馬，歲牧於鎮江。

translations.literal: Previously, horses established by the Sichuan circuit were pastured annually at Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, horses from the Sichuan circuit were pastured annually at Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 是年春，上以未見蕃息，遂分送江上諸軍。

translations.literal: That spring, the emperor, not seeing multiplication, distributed them to various armies along the river.
translations.idiomatic: That spring, seeing no multiplication, the emperor distributed them to various armies along the river.

sentences.zh: 後又置監郢、鄂間，牝牡千，十餘年僅生二十駒，且不可用，乃已。

translations.literal: Later a superintendency was established between Ying and E — one thousand mares and stallions; over ten years only twenty foals were born, and unusable — then ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Later a superintendency was established between Ying and E with one thousand breeding horses. Over ten years only twenty foals were born, all unusable, and the effort was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 故凡戰馬，悉仰秦、川、廣三邊焉。

translations.literal: Therefore all war horses relied entirely on the three frontiers of Qin, Chuan, and Guang.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore all war horses relied entirely on the Qin, Chuan, and Guang frontiers.

sentences.zh: 秦馬舊二萬，乾道間，秦、川買馬額歲萬一千九百有奇，川司六千，秦司五千九百。

translations.literal: Qin horses formerly numbered twenty thousand; during Qiandao, Qin and Chuan horse purchase quota annually was eleven thousand nine hundred odd — Chuan bureau six thousand, Qin bureau five thousand nine hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Qin horses formerly numbered twenty thousand. During Qiandao, Qin and Chuan horse purchase quotas totaled more than eleven thousand nine hundred annually — six thousand for the Chuan bureau and five thousand nine hundred for the Qin bureau.

sentences.zh: 益、梓、利三路漕司，歲出易馬紬絹十萬四千疋。

translations.literal: The transport bureaus of Yi, Zi, and Li three circuits annually disbursed one hundred four thousand bolts of silk and gauze for horse exchange.
translations.idiomatic: The transport bureaus of Yi, Zi, and Li three circuits annually disbursed one hundred four thousand bolts of silk and gauze for horse exchange.

sentences.zh: 成都、利州路十一州，產茶二千一百二萬斤。

translations.literal: Eleven prefectures of Chengdu and Lizhou circuits produced twenty-one million two hundred thousand jin of tea.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven prefectures in Chengdu and Lizhou circuits produced twenty-one million two hundred thousand jin of tea.

sentences.zh: 茶馬司所收，大較若此。

translations.literal: What the Tea-Horse Bureau collected was roughly thus.
translations.idiomatic: The Tea-Horse Bureau's receipts were roughly thus.

sentences.zh: 慶元初，合川、秦兩司為萬一千十有六。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qingyuan, the Chuan and Qin two bureaus combined totaled eleven thousand sixteen.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Qingyuan (1195), the Chuan and Qin bureaus combined totaled eleven thousand sixteen horses.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰末，合兩司為萬二千九十四。

translations.literal: At the end of Jiatai, the two bureaus combined totaled twelve thousand ninety-four.
translations.idiomatic: By the end of Jiatai (1204), the two bureaus combined totaled twelve thousand ninety-four horses.

sentences.zh: 然累歲市易，多不及額。

translations.literal: However, over successive years of trade, quotas were often not met.
translations.idiomatic: However, over successive years, purchase quotas were often not met.

sentences.zh: 蓋南渡前，市馬分而為二：其一曰戰馬，生於西郵，良健可備行陣，今宕昌、峰貼峽、文州所產是也；

translations.literal: Before the southern crossing, purchased horses were divided into two: the first called war horses, born in the western frontier posts, fine and strong and suitable for battle formations — what Dangchang, Fengtiexia, and Wenzhou now produce;
translations.idiomatic: Before the southern crossing, purchased horses were divided into two types: war horses, born in the western frontier posts, fine and strong and suitable for battle — such as those produced at Dangchang, Fengtiexia, and Wenzhou;

sentences.zh: 其二曰羈縻馬，產西南諸蠻，短小不及格，今黎、敘等五州所產是也。

translations.literal: the second called tributary-control horses, produced by various southwestern tribes, short and small and failing standards — what Li, Xu, and four other prefectures now produce.
translations.idiomatic: and tributary-control horses, produced by various southwestern tribes, short and substandard — such as those from Li, Xu, and four other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 羈縻馬每綱五十，其間良者不過三五，中等十數，餘皆下等，不可服乘。

translations.literal: Tributary-control horses fifty per convoy — among them fine ones no more than three to five, middling ones a dozen or so, the rest all inferior grade, unsuitable for riding.
translations.idiomatic: Tributary-control horses came fifty per convoy — of these, no more than three to five were fine, about a dozen middling, and the rest inferior and unsuitable for riding.

sentences.zh: 守貳貪賞格，以多為貴。

translations.literal: Prefects and vice-prefects coveted reward standards, valuing quantity.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects and vice-prefects coveted reward standards and valued quantity over quality.

sentences.zh: 經涉險遠，且綱卒盜其芻粟，道斃者相望。

translations.literal: Traversing dangerous and distant routes, and convoy soldiers stealing their fodder and grain — horses dying along the road were visible one after another.
translations.idiomatic: Traversing dangerous and distant routes, with convoy soldiers stealing fodder, dead horses lined the roads.

sentences.zh: 成都府馬務，歲發江上諸軍馬凡五十八綱，月券錢米二百緡，歲計萬一千六百緡。

translations.literal: The Chengdu Prefecture Horse Office annually dispatched fifty-eight convoys of horses to armies along the river; monthly coupon cash and grain two hundred strings — annually totaling eleven thousand six hundred strings.
translations.idiomatic: The Chengdu Prefecture Horse Office annually dispatched fifty-eight convoys to armies along the river, at two hundred strings monthly in coupon cash and grain, totaling eleven thousand six hundred strings per year.

sentences.zh: 興元府馬務，歲發三衙馬百二十綱，其費稱是。

translations.literal: The Xingyuan Prefecture Horse Office annually dispatched one hundred twenty convoys to the Three Yamen — expenses comparable.
translations.idiomatic: The Xingyuan Prefecture Horse Office annually dispatched one hundred twenty convoys to the Three Yamen at comparable expense.

sentences.zh: 率未嘗如數，蓋茶馬司靳錢帛，馬至，價不即償致然也。

translations.literal: Quotas were rarely met — because the Tea-Horse Bureau withheld cash and silk; when horses arrived, prices were not immediately paid, causing this.
translations.idiomatic: Quotas were rarely met because the Tea-Horse Bureau withheld cash and silk, failing to pay promptly when horses arrived.

sentences.zh: 舊蕃蠻中馬，良駑有定價。

translations.literal: Formerly among tribal horses, good and inferior had fixed prices.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly, tribal horses had fixed prices for good and inferior quality.

sentences.zh: 紹興中，張鬆為黎倅，欲馬溢額覬賞，乃高直市之。

translations.literal: During Shaoxing, Zhang Song served as Lizhou vice-prefect; wishing horses to exceed quota to seek rewards, he purchased at high prices.
translations.idiomatic: During Shaoxing, Lizhou Vice-Prefect Zhang Song, hoping to exceed quota and win rewards, purchased horses at inflated prices.

sentences.zh: 夷人無厭，邀求滋甚。

translations.literal: Tribal peoples were insatiable; demands grew ever more excessive.
translations.idiomatic: Tribal peoples grew insatiable and their demands ever more excessive.

sentences.zh: 後邛部川蠻恃功。

translations.literal: Later the Qiongbu River tribes relied on their merits.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Qiongbu River tribes leveraged their service merits.

sentences.zh: 趙彥博始以細茶、錦與之。

translations.literal: Zhao Yanbo first gave them fine tea and brocade.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yanbo first paid them in fine tea and brocade.

sentences.zh: 而夷人每貿馬，以茶、錦不堪藉口。

translations.literal: Yet whenever tribal peoples traded horses, they complained the tea and brocade were unsuitable.
translations.idiomatic: Yet whenever tribal peoples traded horses, they complained the tea and brocade were unsatisfactory.

sentences.zh: 慶元中，金人既失冀北地，馬至秦司亦罕。

translations.literal: During Qingyuan, once the Jurchens lost the Ji north lands, horses reaching the Qin bureau also became rare.
translations.idiomatic: During Qingyuan, after the Jurchens lost the lands north of Ji, horses reaching the Qin bureau became rare.

sentences.zh: 舊川、秦市馬赴密院，多道斃者。

translations.literal: Formerly Chuan and Qin purchased horses sent to the Military Affairs Bureau — many died along the route.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly, Chuan and Qin horses sent to the Military Affairs Bureau suffered heavy losses along the route.

sentences.zh: 紹興二十七年，詔川馬不赴行在，分隸江上諸軍，鎮江、建康、荊、鄂軍各七百五十，江、池軍各五百，殿前司二千五百，馬司、步司各千，川馬良者二百進御。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Shaoxing, it was decreed that Chuan horses not go to the mobile court but be distributed among armies along the river: Zhenjiang, Jiankang, Jing, and E armies each seven hundred fifty; Jiang and Chi armies each five hundred; Palace Front Office two thousand five hundred; Cavalry and Infantry Bureaus each one thousand; two hundred fine Chuan horses presented to the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year of Shaoxing (1157), Chuan horses were ordered not to the mobile court but distributed among river armies: seven hundred fifty each to Zhenjiang, Jiankang, Jing, and E; five hundred each to Jiang and Chi; two thousand five hundred to the Palace Front Office; one thousand each to the Cavalry and Infantry Bureaus; and two hundred fine Chuan horses to the emperor.

sentences.zh: 此十九年所定格也。

translations.literal: This was the quota fixed in the nineteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: This was the quota fixed in the nineteenth year.

sentences.zh: 廣馬者，建炎末，廣西提舉峒丁李棫請市馬赴行在。

translations.literal: Guang horses — at the end of Jianyan, Guangxi Cave-Ding Commissioner Li Yu requested purchasing horses for the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: Guang horses — at the end of Jianyan (1130), Guangxi Cave-Ding Commissioner Li Yu requested purchasing horses for the mobile court.

sentences.zh: 紹興初，隸經畧司。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shaoxing, subordinate to the frontier commission.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Shaoxing, the operation was subordinated to the frontier commission.

sentences.zh: 三年，即邕州置司提舉，市於羅殿、自杞、大理諸蠻。

translations.literal: In the third year, a commissioner-in-chief was established at Yongzhou to purchase from the Luodian, Ziqi, Dali, and other tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, a commissioner was established at Yongzhou to purchase from the Luodian, Ziqi, Dali, and other tribes.

sentences.zh: 未幾，廢買馬司，帥臣領之。

translations.literal: Before long, the Horse Purchase Bureau was abolished and commanders took charge.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Horse Purchase Bureau was abolished and military commanders took charge.

sentences.zh: 七年，胡舜陟為帥，歲中市馬二千四百，詔賞之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Hu Shunzhi served as commander; annually purchased two thousand four hundred horses — rewarded by decree.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Commander Hu Shunzhi purchased twenty-four hundred horses annually and was rewarded by decree.

sentences.zh: 其後馬益精，歲費黃金五鎰，中金二百五十鎰，錦四百，絁四千，廉州鹽二百萬斤，得馬千五百。

translations.literal: Afterward horses grew finer; annually spent five taels of yellow gold, two hundred fifty taels of medium gold, four hundred bolts of brocade, four thousand bolts of silk gauze, two million jin of Lianzhou salt — obtaining one thousand five hundred horses.
translations.idiomatic: Horses grew finer thereafter. Annual expenditure was five taels of yellow gold, two hundred fifty taels of medium gold, four hundred bolts of brocade, four thousand bolts of silk gauze, and two million jin of Lianzhou salt, yielding fifteen hundred horses.

sentences.zh: 須四尺二寸已上乃市之。

translations.literal: Only those four chi two cun and above were purchased.
translations.idiomatic: Only horses four chi two cun and above were purchased.

sentences.zh: 其直為銀四十兩，每高一寸增銀十兩，有至六七十兩者。

translations.literal: Their price was forty taels of silver; each additional cun added ten taels — some reached sixty to seventy taels.
translations.idiomatic: The base price was forty taels of silver, with ten taels added per additional cun in height — some reaching sixty to seventy taels.

sentences.zh: 土人云，尤駔駿者，在其產處，或博黃金二十兩，日行四百里，第官價已定，不能致此。

translations.literal: Locals said the finest swift horses at their place of origin sometimes traded for twenty taels of yellow gold and traveled four hundred li per day — but official prices were fixed and could not obtain these.
translations.idiomatic: Locals said the finest swift horses at their place of origin sometimes traded for twenty taels of yellow gold and traveled four hundred li per day, but fixed official prices could not obtain them.

sentences.zh: 自杞諸蕃本自無馬，蓋轉市之南詔。

translations.literal: The Ziqi tribes originally had no horses themselves — they resold from Nanzhao.
translations.idiomatic: The Ziqi tribes originally had no horses of their own — they resold horses from Nanzhao.

sentences.zh: 南詔，大理國也。

translations.literal: Nanzhao was the Dali kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Nanzhao was the Dali kingdom.

sentences.zh: 乾道九年，大理人李觀音得等二十二人至橫山砦求市馬，知邕州姚恪盛陳金帛誇示之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Qiandao, twenty-two Dali people including Li Guanyinde arrived at Hengshan Stockade seeking to purchase horses; Yongzhou Prefect Yao Ke lavishly displayed gold and silk to impress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Qiandao (1173), twenty-two Dali envoys including Li Guanyinde arrived at Hengshan Stockade seeking to trade horses. Yongzhou Prefect Yao Ke lavishly displayed gold and silk to impress them.

sentences.zh: 其人大喜，出一文書，稱「利貞二年十二月」，約來年以馬來。

translations.literal: They were greatly pleased and produced a document dated "twelfth month, second year of Lizhen," promising to bring horses the following year.
translations.idiomatic: They were greatly pleased and produced a document dated "twelfth month, second year of Lizhen," promising to bring horses the following year.

sentences.zh: 所求《文選》、《五經》、《國語》、《三史》、《初學記》及醫、釋等書，恪厚遺遣之，而不敢上聞也。

translations.literal: They requested the Wen Xuan, Five Classics, Discourses of the States, Three Histories, Primary Learning Record, and medical and Buddhist texts — Ke generously sent them as gifts but dared not report upward.
translations.idiomatic: They requested the Wen Xuan, Five Classics, Discourses of the States, Three Histories, Primary Learning Record, and medical and Buddhist texts. Ke generously sent them as gifts but dared not report to the throne.

sentences.zh: 嶺南自產小駟，匹直十餘千，與淮、湖所出無異。

translations.literal: Lingnan itself produced small ponies, ten-odd thousand per horse — no different from those of the Huai and lake regions.
translations.idiomatic: Lingnan itself produced small ponies at ten-odd thousand per horse, no different from those of the Huai and lake regions.

sentences.zh: 大理連西戎，故多馬，雖互市於廣南，其實猶西馬也。

translations.literal: Dali connected with the Western Rong, therefore had many horses; although traded at Guangnan, in fact they were still western horses.
translations.idiomatic: Dali bordered the Western Rong and had many horses. Although traded at Guangnan, they were in fact still western horses.

sentences.zh: 每擇其良赴三衙，餘以付江上諸軍。

translations.literal: Each time the finest were selected for the Three Yamen; the remainder given to armies along the river.
translations.idiomatic: The finest were selected for the Three Yamen; the remainder distributed to armies along the river.

sentences.zh: 寶慶四年，兩淮制府貿易北馬五千餘，而他郡亦往往市馬不輟。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Baoqing, the Two Huai commandery traded more than five thousand northern horses; other prefectures also frequently purchased horses without cease.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Baoqing (1228), the Two Huai commandery traded more than five thousand northern horses, and other prefectures also continued purchasing horses.

sentences.zh: 咸淳末，有紀智立者獻謀，以為兩淮軍將、武官、巨室皆畜馬，率三借二，二借一，一全起，團結隊伍，借助防江，各令飼馬役夫自乘之官，優給月錢一年，以半年為約，江面寧即放歸。

translations.literal: At the end of Xianchun, one Ji Zhili submitted a plan: Two Huai military officers, martial officials, and great households all kept horses — generally three borrow two, two borrow one, one fully mobilized — forming organized units to assist river defense; each horse-keeping laborer would ride his own horse for the government, generously given monthly pay for one year, with six months as the term; when the river was calm, release them to return.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Xianchun, Ji Zhili submitted a plan: Two Huai military officers, martial officials, and wealthy households all kept horses. Units would be formed on a graduated mobilization basis — three borrow two, two borrow one, one fully called up — to assist river defense. Horse-keeping laborers would ride their own horses for the government with generous monthly pay for one year on six-month terms, released when the river was calm.

sentences.zh: 又云，陳巖守招信，團馬至七千，出沒張耀，此其驗也。

translations.literal: He also said Chen Yan defended Zhaoxin, organized seven thousand horses, appearing and disappearing with great display — this was the proof.
translations.idiomatic: He also cited Chen Yan's defense of Zhaoxin, where seven thousand organized horses appeared and disappeared with great effect, as proof of the concept.

sentences.zh: 臣僚言：宜倣祖宗遺意，亟謀和市馬，如出一馬，則免其某色力役。

translations.literal: Officials said: The founding ancestors' intent should be followed; horse purchase should be urgently planned — for each horse contributed, exempt certain corvée labor.
translations.idiomatic: Officials argued that the founding ancestors' intent should be followed and horse purchase urgently planned — exempting certain corvée obligations for each horse contributed.

sentences.zh: 惟是川、秦之馬，遵陸則崇岡復嶺，盤回斗絕；

translations.literal: However, Chuan and Qin horses — overland there are lofty ridges and layered peaks, winding and precipitous;
translations.idiomatic: However, transporting Chuan and Qin horses overland meant crossing lofty ridges and layered peaks on winding, precipitous routes;

sentences.zh: 舟行則峽江湍急，灘磧險惡。

translations.literal: by boat there are gorge rivers with swift currents, shoals and rapids dangerous and treacherous.
translations.idiomatic: while transport by boat meant navigating gorge rivers with swift currents and treacherous shoals and rapids.

sentences.zh: 每綱運，公私經費十倍，而人馬俱疲。

translations.literal: Each convoy transport — public and private expenses tenfold — and both men and horses exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Each convoy cost ten times normal public and private expenses, exhausting both men and horses.

sentences.zh: 上則耗國用，下則困州縣。

translations.literal: Above it depleted state resources; below it distressed prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: It depleted state resources above and distressed prefectures and counties below.

sentences.zh: 綱兵所經，甚於寇賊。

translations.literal: Where convoy soldiers passed was worse than bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Where convoy soldiers passed wrought worse havoc than bandits.

sentences.zh: 雖臣僚條奏更迭，終莫得其要領。

translations.literal: Although officials submitted detailed memorials in succession, ultimately none grasped the essentials.
translations.idiomatic: Although officials submitted detailed memorials in succession, none ultimately grasped the essentials.

sentences.zh: 豈馬政各因風土之宜，而非東南之利歟？

translations.literal: Is it not that horse administration each adapts to local conditions, and is not suited to the southeast's advantage?
translations.idiomatic: Was it not that horse administration must adapt to local conditions, and was ill suited to the advantages of the southeast?
